it.name: Swipewipe: Photo Cleaner
it.d:
Your camera roll is a mess. Let's fix it.

Reclaim your storage and rediscover your best memories with Swipewipe. We make cleaning up thousands of photos not just easy, but genuinely fun. It's the photo **declutter** tool you'll actually want to use.

Finally, a simple way to manage your memories. Go month-by-month to tackle your library, relive golden moments with our "On This Day" feature, and explore your travels on a beautiful, interactive memory map. This isn't a chore-it's a trip down memory lane.

Decide what to keep and what to delete with a simple swipe.

Why you'll be obsessed with Swipewipe:

- The Famous Swipe: Swipe right to keep, left to delete. Cleaning your photo **organizer** has never been so addictive.
- Relive Your Best Days: The "On This Day" feature and home screen widget serve up daily doses of nostalgia, complete with streaks to keep you motivated.
- Your Adventures, Mapped: See all the places you've been and the memories you've made on a stunning world map.
- AI-Powered Enhancement: Magically improve old, blurry, or low-quality photos. Turn forgotten pictures into crisp, clear keepsakes.
- Find the Clutter Fast: Easily spot and remove **similar** photos, blurry shots, and old **screenshots** that are eating up your storage.
- Decide Later: Not sure about a photo? Bookmark it and come back to it anytime. No pressure.

Your camera roll should be a highlight reel, not a source of stress. Free up gigabytes of space, find your favorite photos again, and finally take control of your digital memories.

Ready to fall in love with your camera roll again?
Download Swipewipe and start your most satisfying cleanup yet!

it.name: NeoServer SSH Mosh Terminal
it.d:
NeoServer manages your servers over SSH, with no extra software to install.

Whether it's a Home Server, NAS, cloud server, development environment, or AI compute node, you can connect, monitor, manage files, and operate containers directly through NeoServer.

◉ Terminal and Remote Access

• Mosh support — stays connected when switching networks
• Deep tmux and zellij support for fast session recovery after disconnects
• Built for Claude Code, with direct paste or upload of images, videos, and files
• Password, Private Key, 2FA, and SSH Agent forward authentication
• Jump Server, Failover, and Socks5 Proxy support
• Automatically run Shell initialization scripts after connecting
• Built-in special keyboard, copy and paste, and quick actions
• Command completion hints, with double-tap to trigger TAB
• Custom themes and fonts, including programming ligature fonts


◉ AI Assistant
No Agent installation required. Manage your servers directly with AI: it can read metrics, run commands, and manage files — like an always-on operations assistant that helps you handle complex maintenance tasks.
• Supports mainstream LLM APIs via standard protocols. No model service is included — bring your own API configuration for any provider you need
• Custom Skills system: AI can read and create skills, synced across devices via iCloud
• Built-in browser skill: AI can open web pages, extract content, and run scripts in-app
• Local file sandbox: AI can read and write local files with live preview
• Runs continuously in the background, with automatic notifications when tasks complete
• Upload images, screenshots, and files for AI to analyze in context
• Plan mode: plan first, then execute — more control over complex tasks

◉ File Management (SFTP)

• Browse server files and directories
• Upload, download, delete, and rename files
• View file size, permissions, and modification time
• Edit files online
• Syntax highlighting for common programming languages
• Preview images, logs, configuration files, and more

◉ Batch Script Execution

• Run scripts on one or multiple servers
• Organize servers into groups
• View script execution history
• Run maintenance tasks in batches at once
• Suitable for batch updates, deployments, and inspections

◉ Server Monitoring

View server status in real time:

• Uptime
• 1 / 5 / 15 minute system load
• CPU model, temperature, and usage
• Memory usage
• GPU usage and GPU task information
• Disk capacity, IOPS, and I/O Wait
• Disk read/write speed and total read/write volume
• Network upload and download speed
• Total traffic statistics

Key metrics can also be shown directly in iOS widgets.

◉ Process Management

• View the system process list
• Show PID, user, CPU, memory usage, and more
• Sort by columns
• Send signals to terminate processes

◉ Docker and Podman Management

• View container status
• View container logs
• View Inspect information
• Create, start, stop, and restart containers
• Pause and delete containers
• Manage images and container resources

◉ Remote Wake and Automation

• Wake-on-LAN (WOL) remote startup
• Wake LAN devices with one tap
• Remote shutdown and daily operations support
• Great for NAS and Home Server users

◉ Security and Data Sync

• Face ID / Touch ID app protection
• Sync data with your private iCloud storage

◉ Who NeoServer Is For

• Home Server enthusiasts
• NAS users (Synology, QNAP, TrueNAS, and more)
• Website administrators and operations engineers
• Developers and programmers
• AI model researchers
• Cloud server administrators

◉ Feedback and issues: makerneo.lab@gmail.com

◉ Data Privacy:
◦ Your private data — such as SSH private keys and server configurations — is stored only on your device and your own iCloud storage (if you enable sync). It is never uploaded to our servers or shared with any third party.
◦ Privacy Policy: https://www.joyk.com/en/doc/neoserver-privacy.html
◦ Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

it.name: Truecaller: Premium Caller ID
it.d:
With Truecaller, you can identify and block spam calls, search unknown numbers, and help protect your family with Family Protection.
With Truecaller Travel eSIM, you can now stay connected worldwide with seamless mobile data while traveling.

Trusted by over 500 million users, Truecaller uses smart spam detection to help protect you from unwanted calls, scams, and fraud while keeping your communication safe and under control.

CALLER ID & SPAM BLOCKING
• A new Caller ID experience on iPhone with iOS 18.2 and above
• Automatically identify spam, fraud, scam, and robocalls before you pick up
• View and search previously identified calls directly in the Phone app
• Block unwanted callers and reduce spam calls
• Enable spam identification via Settings > Apps > Phone > Call Blocking & Identification
• A paid subscription is required to access this feature

TRUECALLER FAMILY PLAN: PROTECT YOUR LOVED ONES
Share Truecaller Premium with your family and help keep your loved ones protected from spam, scam, and fraud calls.

• Add up to 4 family members to your plan
• Share Premium benefits with your family
• Help your loved ones identify spam and fraud calls
• Keep your family safer from unwanted callers
• One subscription for the whole family

TRUECALLER eSIM: GLOBAL DATA FOR TRAVEL
Stay connected worldwide with Truecaller eSIM — fast, secure, and reliable mobile data wherever you travel.

• Coverage in 155 countries across Europe, Americas, Asia, and more
• Instant activation — no physical SIM required
• Affordable prepaid plans with transparent pricing
• No hidden roaming fees or unexpected charges
• Flexible data options for any trip duration
• Secure, stable connectivity wherever you go

Available for users from selected markets:
Italy, Sweden, Spain, France, Germany, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Netherlands, Belgium, Ireland, Austria, Finland, Czech Rep., Denmark, Hungary, United States, United Kingdom, Australia, Canada, New Zealand, Switzerland, Norway, Chile, Indonesia, Malaysia, South Africa, Egypt, Nigeria

IDENTIFY ANY NUMBER
• Search any phone number to find the name and relevant information
• Works for both local and international numbers
• Easily search numbers from your call history via share extension

TRUECALLER PREMIUM: UPGRADE YOUR EXPERIENCE
• Automatically identify and block spam calls
• Remove all ads
• Unlimited number lookups
• See who viewed your profile
• Family Plan for up to 4 members
• Premium badge on your profile
• Auto-renewing subscription with a free trial for new users

Truecaller respects your privacy. Your phonebook is never made searchable or public.

Terms of use: https://www.truecaller.com/terms-of-service
Please note: Payment for auto-renewing subscriptions will be charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your Account Settings.

it.name: Cleanup: Phone Storage Cleaner
it.d:
Clean up your iPhone and optimize storage in seconds. 

Remove duplicate photos, videos, and junk emails. Cleanup helps you clear your camera roll, merge duplicate contacts, compress videos, and organize storage — all in one app.

OPTIMIZE STORAGE – FREE UP SPACE WITH ONE TAP
Running low on space? Cleanup gives you powerful tools to take control:
- Delete duplicate photos and videos
- Remove similar screenshots and lookalike videos
- Compress large files without losing quality
- Clean up spam and promotional emails
- Delete unused contacts and tidy up your address book
- Free up storage instantly with one tap.

CLEAN YOUR GALLERY FAST - DELETE DUPLICATE PHOTOS
No more manual browsing. Cleanup makes it easy:
- Instantly detect and delete duplicate photos
- Smart grouping for similar photos, with “Best” marked
- Remove large, lookalike videos
- Identify and delete screenshots in bulk

EMAIL CLEANER - DECLUTTER YOUR INBOX
Declutter your inbox in seconds:
- Highlight and remove promo, spam, and unread emails
- Clear out junk with one tap

CONTACTS CLEANUP
Keep your contacts organized and up to date:
- Merge duplicates
- Remove incomplete or unused entries
- View and edit from one place

COMPRESS VIDEOS  - SAVE SPACE, KEEP QUALITY
Save storage without deleting memories:
- Compress large files with minimal quality loss
- Select exactly which videos to compress

CHARGING ANIMATIONS
Turn charging into a personal moment with vivid, customizable animations.

SECRET SPACE – HIDE WHAT’S PERSONAL
Hide personal content in a secure, PIN-protected vault only you can access.

WIDGETS
Add instant cleanup tools to your Home and Lock Screens:
- Battery and storage widgets
- Tap to launch cleanup features quickly

REVIEW BEFORE YOU DELETE
Nothing is removed without your approval.  After each cleaning session, you get a final review screen to double-check your selections.
 No accidental deletions, no surprises — you're always in control.

OFFLINE AND PRIVATE
Your data stays private:
- No internet connection needed
- No files leave your phone
- No tracking or data misuse

Your privacy is fully protected — even we can’t access your photos.



Payment & Subscription Terms:


Choose between the following subscription options for unlimited access to all features:


• Weekly Subscription
• Lifetime Subscription


FREE TRIAL FOR 7 DAYS - OFFERING UNLIMITED GALLERY CLEANING FOR A LIMITED TIME


***You may cancel your subscription at any time***


Cleanup’s free trial allows you unlimited access to all features for the duration of 7 days. Your account will be automatically charged for renewal, based on the annual subscription plan, within 24 hours before the end of the 7 days free trial period.


You can cancel auto-renewal at any time, given that the cancellation is at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when making a purchase of an auto-renewing subscription.


***Manage your subscription directly from your iPhone***
Subscriptions can be managed by the user and auto-renewal can be turned off by going to the Account Settings:
- Open the Settings app.
- Tap your name.
- Tap Subscriptions.
- Tap the subscription that you want to manage.


Privacy policy: https://cleanup.photos/privacy
Terms of use: https://cleanup.photos/terms

it.name: Aloha Browser – Private VPN
it.d:
Your privacy should be the default, not a feature. Aloha Browser gives you everything you need to browse privately, block ads and trackers, and download files — in one app, with nothing extra to install.
Hundreds of millions of users trust Aloha because it does what other browsers won't: it puts your privacy first by default, not as an afterthought.

BLOCK ADS AUTOMATICALLY
Ads slow you down and track you across the web. Aloha removes them before they load — every page is faster, cleaner, and distraction-free with no ads. No setup required.

BROWSE WITH A BUILT-IN FREE VPN
Protect your connection on any network with Aloha's integrated VPN. Choose from 80+ server locations worldwide, secured with 256-bit AES encryption and DNS leak protection. VPN traffic is compressed and encrypted to reduce bandwidth usage. One tap to activate — no separate app, no data caps for everyday use.

DOWNLOAD VIDEOS AND FILES
Save videos, music, and documents directly from any web page. Aloha's built-in downloader handles the formats other browsers can't. Play media in the background, manage files with ease, and lock sensitive downloads with biometric protection.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Aloha doesn't log your activity — ever. There's nothing to share because there's nothing stored. Combined with the VPN, automatic ad blocking, and TrafficMask, you get full-stack privacy that goes far beyond what incognito mode offers.

PRIVATE AI — NO SURVEILLANCE
Use AI to summarize, translate, and answer questions without your prompts being logged, profiled, or used to train models. Private by default.

BUILT FOR YOUR DAILY WEB
Tabbed browsing with a clean, fast interface. Sync bookmarks and tabs across devices linked to your Aloha account. Scan QR codes instantly. Explore Web3 domains and dApps with full native support. Everything works together, beautifully.

ALOHA PREMIUM
Upgrade for enhanced VPN country selection, device-wide VPN protection, VPN auto-start, Wi-Fi file sharing, ZIP compression support, and premium themes.
Aloha Premium is available at $7.99/month or $69.99/year (USD). Prices may vary by region. Subscriptions renew automatically unless turned off at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage subscriptions in your Apple Account settings. Any unused free trial portion is forfeited upon purchase.
Privacy policy: https://alohabrowser.com/policy.html
Terms & Conditions: https://alohabrowser.com/terms.html

ABOUT ALOHA
We're a team dedicated to proving that privacy and a great browsing experience aren't mutually exclusive. While other browsers bolt on privacy features as add-ons, we built Aloha from the ground up to keep your data yours — verified by an independent third-party audit from Leviathan Security Group.

Discover more: https://alohabrowser.com
Facebook: https://facebook.com/alohavpnbrowser
X: https://x.com/alohabrowser
For feedback and support, please email support@alohabrowser.com

Tired of cookie pop-ups on every website?

Super Agent automates cookie consent based on your preferences. Set once, applies everywhere.

Choose your preferences for Advertising, Functional, and Performance cookies. Super Agent fills out consent forms automatically on supported sites.
Site not working? Tap Report. AI analyzes patterns to add coverage faster—without accessing your data.

Features:
- Automatic consent for Safari on iOS/iPad
- One-time setup, works across thousands of sites
- Optional encrypted Consent Trail
- Subscribers get priority for site reports
- Zero tracking, zero data selling

Browse without interruptions. Your privacy, your control.

Build your English vocabulary the smart way. LookUp combines an Oxford-powered dictionary with beautiful Word of the Day, spaced repetition quizzes, and personal word collections, all in one award-winning app.

Discover words beautifully: A new illustrated Word of the Day, every day. Visual memory aids make new words stick faster than reading definitions alone. Tap the widget on your Home Screen or Lock Screen to never miss a word.

Look up any word, instantly: Powered by Oxford English Dictionary; the world's most trusted source. Get definitions, thesaurus, audio pronunciations, example sentences, usage notes, and translations in 20+ languages.

Build your personal vocabulary: Save words to your own collections. Then master them with flashcards, example sentence quizzes, conversation practice, and interactive exercises — all powered by scientifically proven Spaced Repetition.

Perfect for exams & every day life: Whether you're prepping for GRE, SAT, TOEFL, IELTS, or simply a lover of words. LookUp is built for anyone serious about language.

App Store Editor's Choice · Webby Honoree 2021 · MacStories Update of the Year 2019 "Far and away my favorite dictionary app." - MacStories

—
*Translations Supported for: Arabic, Chinese, Hindi, Indonesian, Malay, Turkmen, Tajik, German, Italian, Greek, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Spanish, Tatar, Igbo, isiXhosa, isiZulu, Northern Sotho, Setswana, Yoruba, Tok Pisin, and more to come.

it.name: 1Blocker: Ad Blocker
it.d:
1Blocker lets you block obtrusive ads, sneaky trackers, and annoying elements on sites. With 1Blocker, you’re safe online and nothing will distract you from enjoying sites.

1Blocker is very easy to use — just flip a couple of switches to start blocking ads and trackers. The app will automatically receive cloud updates to the built-in filters silently, so you don’t need to do anything. It’s as simple as setting and forgetting.

1Blocker is a fully native app designed to extend Safari naturally. It’s lightweight and doesn’t drain your battery by taking up your device’s resources.

The blocking itself is super fast because Safari does it itself. We only provide filters to Safari and don’t modify webpages in any way. This vastly improves efficiency because Safari knows in advance what should be blocked. So, with 1Blocker, sites load on average 2-5x faster.

It’s important to note that not all ads can be blocked though. Some sites use techniques that make it impossible for us to block their ads using currently available features for Safari content blockers.

SECURE BY DESIGN

1Blocker is secure and private. It doesn’t have access to webpages and doesn’t track you in any way.

We believe that privacy is not for sale. That's why we don't have an "Acceptable Ads" program. We stay independent, and the only way we make money is through direct sales of 1Blocker in the App Store to you.

ADVANCED CUSTOMIZATION

1Blocker is a highly customizable content blocker, providing the possibility to create powerful custom rules. It allows you to create custom rules that block any URL by providing a regular expression or hide any element by CSS. It also lets you block cookies. (Available in Premium)

AVAILABLE ON ALL DEVICES

1Blocker is available for iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Your preferences and custom rules are always in sync through iCloud no matter which device you're using.

FEATURED IN THE PRESS

1Blocker has been featured in TechCrunch, Lifehacker, MacStories, Macworld, and many more.

FEATURES AVAILABLE FOR FREE

• The ability to enable one category (for example, Block Ads only)
• Whitelisting sites right from the Safari extension
• Whitelist synchronization between devices via iCloud

FRIENDLY SUPPORT

Send your feedback at @1BlockerApp on Twitter or via email. Your feedback is always very welcome and considered for the next release.


We have been making 1Blocker since 2015. We believe it’s the best all-around package currently available in the App Store.

Privacy Policy: https://1blocker.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://1blocker.com/terms

it.name: Sky Guide
it.d:
Bring the beauty of the stars down to Earth. Hold Sky Guide® overhead to automatically identify any star, constellation, planet or satellite! Easy to use and powerful, it’s epic stargazing for any experience level.

Is it a star or the planet Mars? Knowing what’s up in your night sky is easier than ever. Sky Guide’s AR mode superimposes figures onto your real sky so visualizing the heavens becomes effortless. Have you ever wished you could recognize constellations but didn’t want to fumble around with paper star charts? Now you can.

A speck of light crosses the night sky, growing brighter. What could it be? You don’t have to wonder anymore. Track a bright satellite and receive perfectly-timed notifications whenever the International Space Station is about to fly over your location. With Sky Guide, you’ll be saying ‘Goodbye, aliens’ and ‘Hellooooo, astronauts!’

Voyage to the past or future with cinematic time controls. Know where the Moon will be later in the evening so you can capture that perfect photo or be an eyewitness to history’s greatest comets.

Whether you’re searching for Sagittarius, Saturn, or the next big meteor shower, Sky Guide is jam-packed with information and rich graphics that will satisfy the most curious minds. Plus, stay current with location-filtered events like solar and lunar eclipses with Sky Guide’s personalized Calendar.

Camping in the backcountry? Sky Guide can function with or without Wi-Fi, cellular service or GPS, so everything is at your fingertips no matter where you go.

Join the millions who have discovered a more personal connection to the stars with Sky Guide. It might forever change the way you look up.

it.name: Windy.app — Wind, Tides, Radar
it.d:
Windy.app - wind, waves and weather forecast app for surfers, kitesurfers, windsurfers, sailors, fishermen and other wind sports. 

FEATURES:
•  Wind report, forecast and statistics: wind map, accurate wind compass, wind meter, wind gusts and wind directions. It’s very useful for extreme wind sports.
•  Wind alert: Set up windalert and be aware of wind, storm and tornado warning via push-notifications
•  Weather history (archive) for 2012-2024: view wind data, temperature (day and night) and atmospheric pressure. Weather archive will help you to choose the best month for travel to the spot.
•  Local forecast from NOAA: temperature in Celsius, Fahrenheit and Kelvin, humidity, wind speed, precipitation (rain and snow). Forecast for 10 days with 3 hours step in metric or imperial units: m/s (mps), mph, km/h, knt (knout), bft (beaufort), m, ft, mm, cm, in, hPa, inHg. NOAA is a National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration / National Weather Service (nws).
•  Wave forecast: ocean or sea conditions, ocean waves and sea swell, fishing forecast
•  Animated wind tracker: weather radar for sailing, yachting and kiting in light wind
•  Cloud base/Dewpoint (dew point) data: necessary weather information for pleasant paragliding 
•  Spots: over 30.000 spots sorted and located by the type and area. Add your spots to favourites.
•  Spot chats. Got anemometer? Share info about weather conditions and wind direction in the chat from a kite spot.
•  Community: exchange weather reports on the spot. Want to be a local/spot leader? Email us the name of your spot at feedback@catchwind.co and we will create a chat for it.
•  Weather Stations: online data from nearby online weather stations.
•  Offline Mode: activate offline mode and check the forecast for your activities without internet connection.

PERFECT FOR:
• Kitesurfing (kitesurf)
• Windsurfing (wind surf)
• Surfing
• Sailing (Boating)
• Yachting
• Paragliding
• Fishing
• Snowkiting 
• Snowboarding
• Skiing
• Skydiving
• Kayaking (kayak)
• Wakeboarding
• Cycling
• Hunting (hunt)
• Golf

--------------------------
The free version allows you to use basic app functions.
WINDY PRO Account auto-renewable subscription allows using all functions of this app. Subscription length periods: 1 month with 3 days free trial, and 1 year with 7 days free trial.
Payment for WINDY PRO Account subscriptions will be charged to your iTunes account at the time of purchase. Your subscription will be automatically renewed every 30 or 365 days. If you have never subscribed to a monthly Premium account subscription before, you will have the option of getting a free 3/7-day trial period. Cancelling the trial period will immediately disable your subscription.
Payment for subscription renewals will be charged to your account within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can disable subscription renewal in your iTunes account settings on your device.

it.name: Textastic Code Editor
it.d:
Textastic is a comprehensive and versatile text and code editor for iPad and iPhone. It supports syntax highlighting for more than 80 programming and markup languages. Connect to SFTP, FTP, and WebDAV servers or to your Dropbox account. Use the built-in SSH terminal to work directly on your server.

Features:
- Syntax highlighting for more than 80 languages, including HTML, JavaScript, CSS, C++, Swift, Objective-C, Rust, XML, Markdown, PHP, Perl, Python, Ruby, Lua, YAML, JSON, SQL, shell scripts, and many more (full list available on the website)
- Compatible with Sublime Text 3 and TextMate 1 syntax definitions and themes
- Code completion for HTML, CSS, JavaScript, C, Objective-C, and PHP
- SFTP (SSH), FTP, FTPS (FTP over SSL), WebDAV, and Dropbox clients
- SSH terminal connections
- Code formatter for HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and JSON
- Git repositories from the Git client app Working Copy can be opened as external folders in Textastic
- Emmet support
- JavaScript console
- iCloud Drive file synchronization
- WebDAV server for easy file transfer between Textastic and your Mac or PC over Wi-Fi
- Symbol list for quick navigation within a file
- Full support for external keyboards, trackpads, and mice
- Configurable keyboard shortcuts
- Additional keys above the virtual keyboard for frequently used programming characters
- Cursor navigation wheel for easy text selection
- Move the cursor using swipe gestures
- Split View and Slide Over multitasking on iPad
- Open multiple files in tabs
- Multiple windows on iPadOS
- Dark Mode support
- Support for common text encodings such as UTF-8, UTF-16, and ISO-8859-1
- Support for different tab widths and soft tabs (spaces instead of tabs)
- Custom fonts
- Find and Replace, including regular expression search
- Find in multiple files
- File information such as character and word counts
- Local and remote web preview for HTML and Markdown files

Pricing:
Textastic requires a monthly or yearly subscription or a one-time purchase. Each subscription includes a 7-day free trial with full access to all features.

Privacy Policy: https://www.textasticapp.com/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

it.name: Translate Now - AI Translator
it.d:
Translate text, voice, and photos in 320+ languages. Includes translator keyboard and immersive tools.

Translate Now is your ultimate AI-powered language translator built for travel, daily use, and multilingual communication. Instantly translate languages with voice, text, photo, and camera-based tools. Our smart language translator adapts to your needs with advanced AI, making global conversations seamless.

▶ What translation tools are available?
Translate Now provides real-time translation for text, voice, and photos, along with a Translator Keyboard for your favorite apps.

▶ How many languages are supported?
Over 320 languages are available. Text, speak, type, or point your camera and translate between English, Spanish, Japanese, French, German, Chinese, Korean, Arabic, Hebrew, Vietnamese, Bangla, Jamaican, and many more.

▶ How do I translate live conversations in real time?
Use our Hands-Free AI Voice Translator to speak and translate instantly. Perfect for real-time, two-way communication - no typing needed. Ideal for travel, work meetings, or casual chats in over 320 various languages.

▶ How can I translate photos?
Snap a photo of a menu, sign, or any printed text and get real-time translation with our Photo Translator. For a more immersive translation experience, use the AR Camera Translator and understand the world around you through your device’s camera.

▶ Want to chat in multiple languages on your phone?
Use the Translator Keyboard to type in your language and send live translations in 60+ languages in any app.

▶ How accurate is the text translation?
Switch between AI translation models to get the best accuracy for each language and translate in 320+ languages with context-aware results, phonetic transcription, and grammar tips.

▶ Can I use Translate Now to learn a new language?
Yes. Our AI Dictionary, Grammar Assistant and Lingo AI offers contextual word meanings, real-time grammar corrections and tailored solutions to help with any of your language needs.

More Smart Translation Tools
- AI Translation Models for accurate, intelligent results
- Phrasebook, Watch App, and Translation Extension
- Offline Mode, Dark Mode, Siri Shortcuts, and SharePlay
- Interactive Widgets for fast access

FREE Try Before You Buy 14 Day Trial; your App Store account is not charged by Apple during the free trial. Rated 4.8 stars with over 1.12M downloads. The trusted construction calculator used by professionals across the US and the world.

The go-to feet-inch-fraction calculator for framers, contractors, and builders. Includes Construction Master Pro and Construction Master Pro Trig in one app, with the CMPro Training Guide built in.

Built with the same core engine that powers the industry-standard advanced construction-math calculators from Calculated Industries. Award-winning tools trusted by the industry for 40 years.

BUILT FOR THE JOBSITE
• Framers and carpenters: rafter cuts, stair layouts, lumber quantities, and framing calculations on the job 
• Builders and general contractors: estimates, material takeoffs, and building layouts 
• Concrete and masonry: footing volume, block counts, and unit conversions
• Roofing contractors: bundles, squares, pitch, and slope in seconds 

WHY PROFESSIONALS CHOOSE CONSTRUCTION MASTER® PRO
• Powerful built-in calculations make CMPro ideal for completing layouts, plans, bids, and estimates 
• Work in and convert between all common building dimensional formats US & Metric 
• Built-in right angle functions simplify square-ups, rafters, slopes, and more 
• Handles framing, roofing, concrete, lumber, and stair calculations in one app
• Full trigonometric functions for advanced construction math

BUILT-IN SOLUTIONS 
• Dimensional Math and Conversions 
• Feet-Inch-Fraction, Inch Fraction, Yards 
• Decimal Feet and Inches (10ths, 100ths) 
• Preset Fractions (1/2" through 1/64") 
• D:M:S, Decimal Degree Entry and Conversions 
• Full Metric Function (m, cm, mm) 

RIGHT ANGLE SOLUTIONS 
• Complete Right Angle/Rafter Calculations 
• Pitch Key (Slope and Grade) 
• Rise, Run, Diagonal/Common Rafter Keys 
• Regular and Irregular Hip/Valley & Jack Rafter Keys 
• Rafter Cutting Angles (Plumb, Cheek, and Level Cuts) 
• Stair Layouts (including – Riser Limit, Stairwell Opening, Headroom, Floor Thickness) 
• Rake-Wall (including Arched) 

AREA AND VOLUME SOLUTIONS 
• Square and Cubic 
• Roof – Bundles, Squares, 4x8 Sheets, Pitch, Plan Area 
• Drywall, Siding and Paneling 4x8, 4x9 and 4x12 
• Column/Cone Area and Volume -- 
• Basic & Advanced Circular Calculations 
• Weight per Volume Conversions 
• Length, Width, and Height Keys

it.name: Muslim Pro: Quran & Athan
it.d:
Muslim Pro is a prayer and Quran app built for Muslims who want to build a consistent daily prayer habit, read and listen to the Quran, and find their Qibla direction anywhere in the world. It's especially useful for people managing prayer times while traveling, students memorizing Quran, and anyone building consistency with daily prayers and fasting.

Core features
Accurate Prayer Times & Alerts: Get real-time Athan notifications calculated from your exact location, so you never miss a prayer window whether you're at home or traveling.
Al Quran: Read, Listen & Memorize: Access the complete Holy Quran with audio recitations from multiple reciters and translations in your language, plus dedicated tools for memorization and daily reflection.
Qibla Finder & Islamic Calendar: Instantly find your prayer direction using your phone's compass, and track important Islamic dates with accurate Hijri date calculation.
Prayer & Fasting Tracker: Log your five daily prayers and fasting days to build lasting consistency. Visible streaks and gently timed reminders turn a daily intention into an actual habit.
Duas & Dhikr: A curated collection of daily supplications and remembrance for specific moments (waking up, traveling, eating, difficulty), plus a built-in tasbih counter to track your dhikr, so you always have the right dua on hand.


How does Muslim Pro help me build a consistent prayer habit?
The Prayer & Fasting Tracker logs every prayer and fast automatically, builds a visible streak, and sends reminders timed to your location, so consistency becomes something you can see and reinforce every day, not just something you're aiming for. Gamified Quests add small daily rewards (Stars & Crescents) that reinforce the habit further.

Can Muslim Pro help me during Ramadan?
Yes. The app calculates accurate suhoor and iftar times based on your location, and the Prayer & Fasting Tracker lets you log each fasting day and build a streak throughout the month.

Does Muslim Pro work when I'm traveling?
Yes. Prayer times, Qibla direction, and Athan notifications update automatically based on your current location, and the Halal Restaurant & Prayer Space Finder helps you find nearby options wherever you are.

Is the Quran available offline?
Premium subscribers get offline access to Quran text and audio recitations, so you can read and listen without an internet connection.


More in the app
Halal Restaurants & Prayer Spaces Nearby: find halal eateries and prayer spots wherever you are.
Journaling: track your habit-building progress with mood tracking, picture journaling, and personal notes.
Ummah Pro: a moderated space to share duas and connect with other users.
Gamified Quests: earn Stars & Crescents for completing daily acts of practice, reinforcing your habit over time.


Muslim Pro Premium
Ad-free experience.
Offline Quran reading and audio recitation.
Customizable prayer widgets and interactive lessons.

Pricing (US): $12.99/month or $34.99/year. Pricing varies by country and is charged in local currency. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the current period ends; manage this in your Apple account settings.

Available in: English, Bahasa Indonesia, Bahasa Melayu, Français, العربية, اردو, and more.

it.name: CleanMy®Phone: Cleanup Storage
it.d:
Clean up iPhone storage with CleanMy®Phone — an AI-powered cleaner app crafted by MacPaw. Gently clear years of photos and videos to make room for new memories.

Finding the exact photo you’re looking for amidst gigabytes of random shots, useless videos, similar images, and duplicates may seem impossible. CleanMy®Phone trims unnecessary clutter so you can easily access all your memorable moments.

Why people use CleanMy®Phone
Many iPhone users face common storage and photo-management problems, and CleanMy®Phone helps solve them quickly and safely:

 • iPhone storage is almost full
 • Too many duplicate or similar photos
 • Large videos take too much space
 • Thousands of screenshots and random images
 • Need to organize photos automatically with AI
 • Want a fast, safe way to clean up their iPhone

What can CleanMy®Phone cleaner do?

 • CLEAN UP YOUR IPHONE STORAGE
CleanMy®Phone scans your entire library for blurred photos, old screenshots, large videos, and duplicates — and helps you quickly free up space.

 • DELETE DUPLICATES AND SIMILAR PHOTOS
The app finds duplicate and similar shots, helping you choose the best photo and delete the rest.

 • MERGE SIMILAR CONTACTS
CleanMy®Phone detects duplicate and similar contacts — those with repeated names, numbers, or partial matches — and helps you merge them into a clean, organized address book with one tap.

 • COMPRESS VIDEOS
Compress videos with minimal quality loss to instantly reclaim storage.

 • TURN LIVE PHOTOS TO STILL IMAGES
Convert Live Photos into still images to save space in just one tap.

 • LET AI ORGANIZE YOUR MESSY LIBRARY
AI groups your photos into helpful categories — Travel, People, Pets, Food, Documents, Screenshots, Texts, and more — making your library easier to browse and manage.

•  TREAT YOUR PHOTOS WITH CARE
CleanMy®Phone lets you decide which photos and videos the app removes. If you accidentally delete something, you can always recover it from the Recently Deleted folder on your iPhone.

Beyond smart cleanup tools, CleanMy®Phone also focuses on privacy, control, and a smooth experience for every user.
What makes CleanMy®Phone different?

Your privacy stays on your device
 • CleanMy®Phone works fully on-device
 • You can mark photos as Sensitive so they're never included in cleanups
•  CleanMy®Phone doesn't save or upload your pictures anywhere — you're the only one who can access and see your gallery.

SUBSCRIPTION INFO
You can download the CleanMy®Phone cleaning app for free. The app has a 1-year subscription with a free trial option that allows unlimited access to all features for three days. Your account will be charged for renewal, per your subscription plan, within 24 hours before the end of the 3-day trial period.

You can cancel your free trial at any time within 24 hours before converting your account to an auto-renewable subscription. Please note that any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when purchasing an auto-renewing subscription. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions in Settings after purchase.

By using CleanMy®Phone, you agree to our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use:
Privacy Policy: https://macpaw.com/cleanmyphone-privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://macpaw.com/cleanmyphone-terms-of-use

it.name: NFC Tools
it.d:
NFC Tools can read and write your NFC tags with a simple and lightweight user interface.
By passing your device near an NFC chip, you can read the data it contains and interact with the content.

The "Read" section allows you to see data such as:
- the maker of the tag
- the type of tag (ex : Mifare Ultralight, NTAG213)
- the norm of the tag (ex : NFC Forum Type 2)
- the available technology (ex: NFC A)
- its serial number (ex : 04:85:c8:5a:40:2b:80)
- the size of the tag and of the data on it
- if you can write on the tag
- all the data on the tag (NDEF format)

NFC Tools can record standard information on your tags which will be compatible with any NFC device.
For instance, you can store a VCARD to share your contact details easily, open an URL, share a phone number or even a geolocation.

The "Write" section let you record standardised data such as:
- a simple text
- a link to a website
- an email
- a contact
- a phone number
- a predefined text message
- an address or geolocation
- a WiFi or Bluetooth configuration
- personalised data
- and more...

The write function allows you to add as much data as you wish.
This way you can record large quantities of information on your tag.

The app also allows you to save the contents of your chip for later access.

NFC Tools has been tested with the following NFC tags:
- NTAG 203, 210, 210u, 212, 213, 213TT, 215, 216, 413 DNA, 424 DNA
- Ultralight, Ultralight C, Ultralight EV1
- ICODE SLI, SLI-S, SLIX, SLIX-S, SLIX-L, SLIX2, DNA
- DESFire EV1, EV2, EV3
- ST25TV, ST25TA
- Felica

If you encounter any problem, don’t hesitate to contact us.

Notes:
- Compatible from iPhone 7.
- Use the "compatibility" mode to read/write Mifare Classic tags.

it.name: QR Code Reader，Barcode Scanner
it.d:
Scan QR codes and barcodes instantly with QR Code Reader, a smart QR code and barcode scanner built for everyday life.

Your all-in-one QR code reader, QR code generator, and product scanner. Whether you need to scan a barcode in-store, check a menu, create a custom code, or organize your stock with inventory management, QR Code Reader makes it quick and simple.

How to scan a code?
Open the app, point your camera, and scan any QR code or barcode instantly. QR Code Reader supports all major formats, including QR CODE, EAN13, UPC, ITF14, CODE128, AZTEC, DATAMATRIX, and more. Results appear right away, so you can open links, access product details, or save your scans.

Can I create QR codes and barcodes?
With the built-in QR code generator and barcode maker, you can create custom codes for websites, contact details, promotions, or business use. Personalize your QR codes with templates or use AI-powered customization for marketing and social media branding.

Does QR Code Reader support batch scanning?
QR Code Reader includes a batch barcode scanner so you can scan multiple barcodes at once and save them in folders. This makes it ideal for inventory management, food stock control, or using as an inventory tracker for home or business.

Can I use it for shopping and price comparison?
QR Code Reader doubles as a smart product scanner and price checker. Use it as a Walmart scanner or general price scanner to compare deals instantly and make smarter shopping choices.

How does it help with product and home organization?
Scan barcodes to get nutritional info, product details, and pricing. Track items in your pantry or household with simple inventory tools.

Can I save my scans?
Every scan is automatically stored in your history. With the built-in barcode lookup, you can revisit past scans, search for products, or retrieve contact info from scanned cards.

Is it optimized for iPhone and iPad?
QR Code Reader is designed as a fast QR code scanner for iPhone and a reliable QR reader for iPad. The app delivers smooth performance across iOS devices.

it.name: Oxford Dictionary & Thesaurus
it.d:
Trusted by millions of students, professionals, and language learners worldwide, Oxford Dictionary is powered by Oxford Languages, giving you access to millions of words, definitions, and translations across 18 languages in a single app. Whether you are preparing for exams, improving your writing, or expanding your vocabulary, Oxford Dictionary is your trusted language reference. 

■ What can I use Oxford Dictionary for?
- Find accurate word definitions in English, Spanish, French, and German
- Check pronunciation
- Discover English synonyms and antonyms
- Learn word origins and etymology
- Translate across major languages
- Build vocabulary and improve writing
- Access trusted language references online and offline

■ How many dictionaries are included?
18 Oxford dictionaries: monolingual editions for British and American English, Spanish, French, and German, plus bilingual dictionaries in French, German, Spanish, Russian, Chinese, Italian, Hindi, Urdu, Portuguese, Japanese, Greek, Bulgarian, and Thai.

■ How do I find the meaning of a word?
Search for any word to access trusted Oxford definitions, example usage, phrase support, word origins, and language references powered by Oxford Languages.

■ Does Oxford Dictionary work offline?
Yes. Oxford Dictionary includes full offline access. Download dictionaries to your device and search for words anytime, no internet connection needed. Ideal for travel, studying, or working anywhere.

■ Does Oxford Dictionary include a thesaurus?
Yes. An integrated thesaurus gives you thousands of synonyms and antonyms in English, helping you find the right word, avoid repetition, and improve your writing. Available with Premium.

■ Does Oxford Dictionary have pronunciation support?
Yes. High-quality audio pronunciations in English help you speak with confidence, essential for language learning and exam preparation.

■ Can I search for words even if I don't know the spelling?
Yes. Use voice search, fuzzy search, autocomplete suggestions, keyword lookup, and camera search to find words quickly and easily.

■ Is Oxford Dictionary good for IELTS, TOEFL, SAT, or ACT preparation?
Yes. Oxford Dictionary provides accurate definitions, example usage in context, and a broad vocabulary range trusted by students and academics preparing for major English proficiency exams worldwide.

■ How can I build my vocabulary with Oxford Dictionary?
Save words to Favorites, organise them into folders, revisit Recent searches, and discover a new word every day with Word of the Day.

■ Should I use an AI chatbot instead of a dictionary?
Research shows that students and professionals continue to rely on dedicated dictionaries for formal definitions and verified word usage. Oxford Dictionary provides definitions backed by Oxford Languages' rigorous editorial process, not AI-generated approximations. When accuracy matters, it remains the trusted reference.

■ Who is Oxford Dictionary for?
Students, writers, professionals, academics, language learners, and word enthusiasts — anyone who needs a reliable multilingual dictionary at every level.

■ What do you get with Premium?
- Unlimited database access 
- Offline and fast mode 
- Audio pronunciations 
- Full thesaurus 
- Regular Oxford Languages updates 
- Ad-free experience

■ Why choose Oxford Dictionary?
Oxford Dictionary combines trusted Oxford language expertise with powerful search technology, multilingual support, offline access, and intuitive vocabulary tools, all in one app. Download Oxford Dictionary and experience the world's most trusted language reference.

Transform your smartphone into a document scanner and a mobile office. Easily scan, sign, edit, and convert documents from anywhere—whether you're at home, in the office, or on the move. Scan to PDF & Convert to PDF
Instantly convert or scan in high resolution. Whether it’s photos to PDF, JPG to PDF, or an image to text conversion, get professional-quality scans in seconds.

Edit Documents with Ease
Use the built-in document editor to edit documents, crop, rotate, and enhance scans before sharing. Perfect for contracts, notes, or any other paperwork.

Advanced OCR & Image to Text
Extract text from scanned documents using OCR text scanner technology. Convert image to text, edit content, and copy important details with ease.

Multiple File Formats & Conversions
Seamlessly convert scanned documents with the built-in file converter. Turn JPG to PDF, use the jpeg converter, or convert to PDF for easy sharing.

it.name: WebSSH - Sysadmin Toolbox
it.d:
Whether you're on the go or at your desk, WebSSH keeps you connected — anytime, anywhere! ٩(^‿^)۶

WebSSH is a professional SSH, Mosh, SFTP, Telnet, and Port Forwarding client for iOS and macOS — now with an integrated Proxmox client. Built for developers, system administrators, and IT professionals who need reliable, secure remote access wherever they are.


CONNECT WITH CONFIDENCE

Authenticate with passwords, two-factor challenge, or keys (RSA, DSA, ED25519, PuTTY). Connections are fast and stable, with support for local port forwarding, automatic startup commands, full terminal emulation (XTERM-256COLOR, XTERM, VT100), and custom profiles — themes, fonts, colors, and keyboard shortcuts tailored to your workflow.


MANAGE FILES REMOTELY

The integrated SFTP client lets you browse directories, create, rename, upload, and download files — and edit text files directly within the app. No separate FTP client needed.


MORE THAN SSH

WebSSH also supports Mosh, Telnet, and Serial connections, making it a versatile tool across a wide range of scenarios. Mosh (mobile shell) keeps your session alive through network changes, sleep, and flaky connections — switch from Wi-Fi to cellular and pick up right where you left off. Serial connections support full configuration (baud rate, parity, stop bits, flow control), and Telnet supports both direct and interactive authentication.


PROXMOX AT YOUR FINGERTIPS

NEW: WebSSH now includes a built-in Proxmox client. Connect to one or more Proxmox servers and clusters, monitor your nodes at a glance (CPU, memory, storage), and manage your VMs and LXC containers — start, stop, reboot and migrate them right from your iPhone, iPad, or Mac.


BUILT-IN SYSADMIN TOOLKIT

Quick diagnostics without leaving the app: Ping, Traceroute, DNS Lookup, and Whois. The mashREPL feature gives you a fully local shell (ls, grep, curl, ping, tar, and more) that works even without internet access.


WHY WEBSSH?

Most SSH clients are either too basic or too bloated. WebSSH hits the sweet spot: professional-grade features, a clean mobile-first interface, and rock-solid reliability — every on-device feature unlocked with a single one-time PRO purchase, yours for life.

One app. Every protocol. Zero compromises.

Download WebSSH and keep your servers close at hand, no matter where you are.

it.name: Weather on the Way
it.d:
Check ROAD CONDITIONS and WEATHER on your ROUTE

• Be PREPARED for the road trip
• Say NO to weather delays
• Know EVERYTHING about weather conditions at any point of your road trip
• Be smarter than 99% of drivers around you!
• Access weather and radar on CarPlay

 
Forecast That Follows Your Trip
Weather and navigation combined to provide a route forecast precisely at the time you will be driving through. It's the best weather app you can have on the road. 

Features and benefits:
• Know What's Ahead Before You Get There — See exact weather at every point along your route at the time you'll actually be there
• Leave at the Right Time — Adjust your departure up to 7 days out and instantly find the safest, clearest weather window
• Choose the Smartest Route — Compare alternative routes side by side and take the one with the best conditions
• Never Be Caught Off Guard by Rain or Snow — Live Doppler radar shows real-time precipitation moving toward your route
• Get the Full Picture, Not Just the Temperature — Wind speed, gusts, UV index, visibility, and weather warnings all in one view
• Live Traffic Cameras Along Your Route — View real-time DOT camera feeds along your drive and see exactly what road conditions look like before you get there.
• Plan Multi-Stop Trips With Confidence — Add waypoints and stop durations so your forecast stays accurate across every leg of the journey
• Stay Focused on the Road — Full Apple CarPlay support delivers hands-free weather updates on your dashboard
• Avoid Driving Into Blinding Sun — Sunrise and sunset times are plotted right on your route timeline so you're never caught off guard
• Your Data Stays Yours — No ads, no tracking, no location stored. Just clean, accurate forecasting across 70+ countries

Free & Pro Plans

Free: 
Download and start using Weather on the Way at no cost. Core route forecasting features are included so you can get a feel for the app before committing.

Pro Monthly or Yearly:
Unlock the full power of the app including alternative route comparison, flexible departure time planning and all advanced weather layers. The yearly plan includes a free one-week trial so you can try Pro risk-free.

One-Time Purchase:
Not a fan of subscriptions? A lifetime purchase option is also available, giving you permanent access to all Pro features with a single payment.

Weather on the Way runs on iPhones with iOS 15 and newer.
Strict commitment to user privacy - both the app and our website collects NO personal information. We do not collect your location or chosen driving route.


Global – Works in 70+ countries. Severe weather alerts only in the US, Canada, European Union member nations, and Israel

it.name: Reverso Context Translator
it.d:
Translate and learn millions of words and expressions and express yourself as if you were a native speaker.

Reverso is the best tool for those who seek quality translation, looking to master a foreign language: reading, writing or speaking, and it's free.

Students, teachers, business professionals or others, whether beginners or advanced, use Reverso to learn new words or expressions, and eliminate the risk of being mistaken.

It provides you instant translations of the selected text when reading content on your browser, on Safari or any other app.
 
Reverso Context is based on data gathered from millions of real-life texts (official documents, movie subtitles, product descriptions) in both languages. These texts are processed with powerful "big data" algorithms and machine learning to provide you the best results. 

What do we mean by context? The search results (translation) of a specific word or expression are weaved within real-life sentences, so you will be sure to understand and learn exactly how the word can be used, and make no embarrassing mistakes.  

Just type or say the word or expression you wish to translate and the results will appear instantly:  relevant translations, presented with examples of how words are used in sentences.

The app offers flashcards and quizzes based on your search history and favorites to help you memorize them and to improve your language skills. Unlike standard learning tools, it focuses on words and expressions that you really need and want to learn.

The bits and bytes: 
* Instantly translate selected text when reading content on your browser, iBook or any other app, with no need to exit the app you are using. Click on the familiar "Share" option and select the Reverso option. 
* Translation in 17 languages: Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, German, Polish, Dutch, Arabic, Russian, Romanian, Japanese, Turkish, Hebrew and Chinese, Korean, Swedish, Ukrainian and we are working on more.
* Advanced features include pronunciation, history, phrasebook of your favorites and more.
* Create vocabulary lists based on your personal selection of examples and translations. Lists remain available even when you’re offline. 
* Enjoy natural pronunciation of complete example sentences.
* One click to get translations, frequency details, and  conjugation when applicable.
* Search history, also available offline.
* Suggestions: words and expressions will be suggested to you as you type.
* Share your findings via email or social media.

it.name: Coin ID: Coin Value Identifier
it.d:
Have you always dreamed about an app that would organize your coins for you? Or maybe you want to take up a new non-trivial hobby? Well, meet Coin ID—your guide into the fun world of numismatics! 

What is Coin ID?

Coin Identifier

This app works like magic: take two snaps of the obverse and reverse sides of the coin, and boom—our smart AI will find you a match in mere seconds! 

Coin Guide

Learn everything about your coins: their size, composition, weight, year of minting, country of origin, designer, and even fun facts from their history! The app will also tell you the current reference price of each coin to help you understand its value. Who knows, maybe you’re sitting on a fortune?

Coin Collection

Keep your coins well-organized; add newly identified pieces to your collection to keep track of them at all times. You can create multiple collections to sort your coins in whatever order you like. If you don’t know where to start—try our Official Sets; from State & Territorial Quarters to Presidential Dollars, these sets will get you started and help to channel your inner treasure hunter to collect them all.


Why Coin ID?

Coin ID has the right tools to make any numismatist happy. It offers:

● Fast and accurate coin recognition
● Extensive information about coins from all over the globe
● Possibility to keep record of added coins
● Tracker of the overall number of coins in your collection
● Up-to-date reference prices
● Ability to create multiple collections of coins
● Interesting facts about coins
● Easy-to-use interface

So, what are you waiting for? Discover a new hobby or dive deeper into the world of numismatics to become a coin expert. Coin ID will be at your side on this exciting journey!

Subscribe to Coin ID Premium to get unlimited access to all the app’s features:
• Subscriptions are billed weekly, monthly, or annually at the rate depending on the subscription plan.
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.

All personal data is protected in accordance with the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy:

For any questions or inquiries, please use our customer support form at

it.name: Live Transcribe
it.d:
Live Transcribe by Mighty Fine Apps. Accurate live captions for d/Deaf and hard of hearing. Reliable in noisy places and group settings. Perfect alongside hearing aids when they aren’t enough.

BUILT DIFFERENT

• Accuracy — Best-in-class captions in 145+ languages.
• Noisy Places — Works well in restaurants, in groups, and at distance.
• Offline Mode — Continue when Wi-Fi or cellular drops.
• Privacy — You choose if and when to share your transcripts.
• Readability — Large, bold text for tired eyes and distant viewing.
• Speaker Detection — Follow group chats with color-coded words.
• Simplicity — Easily adopted by older and less-technical people.
• Independent — Sustainable, iOS only, not affiliated with Google.

DESIGNED FOR YOU

• Deaf & Hard of Hearing — Stay independent at home and at work.
• Hearing Aid Users — When aids fall short in noise or in groups.
• Recent Hearing Loss — Rejoin the conversation right away.
• Hearing Spouses & Family — Communicate more easily with a loved one.
• Caregivers & Adult Children — Support a parent, child, or patient.
• Faith-Community Members — Follow sermons, prayers, and group study.

TRUSTED BY THOUSANDS

• 6+ years on the market.
• 15m+ conversations captioned.
• 100m+ minutes transcribed.
• 20k+ paying customers.
• 10k+ App Store reviews at 4.6 stars.
• 100+ hours per year of customer interviews.

Your privacy is our top priority, and the app is designed to give you full control over whether your conversation transcripts — medical, legal, family, end-of-life, or otherwise — are summarized or shared.

LIFE-CHANGING FOR FAMILIES

“This app has changed my 86-year-old mother’s life. It is simple and easy for her and her friends to use. This is so important for the elderly since so many other apps are way too complicated. She can really have one-on-one conversations.” — Mark M

SIMPLE TO USE

• Place iPhone or iPad near the conversation.
• Read what each person is saying on-screen as they speak.
• Follow family dinners, doctor’s appointments, meetings, and more.

HERE TO STAY

Live Transcribe is an independent paid product, and we’re confident in its value. Your subscription allows us to run our captioning service day and night, and keep the app running smoothly on Apple’s devices. We answer to you — our customers and community — not advertisers, so when you need us next year, we’ll still be here. Current pricing is shown in-app and on our website.

MADE IN CALIFORNIA

Live Transcribe is built and supported by Mighty Fine Apps, a tight-knit team based in San Francisco. Our founder Rob Norback first created the app to communicate with his grandfather who was deaf in his later years, and we continue to shape it around the real communication needs of older adults and all those with some level of hearing loss.

FURTHER READING

• About Us: https://livetranscribe.app
• Privacy Policy: https://livetranscribe.app/legal/privacy

~ AIR QUALITY & POLLEN ~

~ CUSTOM APP ICONS & SKINS ~

~ MINIGAME & SURPRISES ~

it.name: Car Scanner ELM OBD2
it.d:
Check what your car is doing in realtime, get OBD fault codes, car performance, sensor data and more!
Car Scanner is a vehicle / car performance / trip computer / diagnostics tool and scanner that uses an OBD II Wi-Fi or Bluetooth 4.0 (Bluetooth LE) adapter to connect to your OBD2 engine management / ECU.
Car Scanner gives you a bunch of unique features:
1) Layout your own dashboard with the gauges and charts you want! 
2) Add custom (extended PIDs) and get information, that was hidden from you by car manufacturer!
3) It can also show and reset a DTC fault code like a scantool.  Car Scanner includes a huge database of DTC codes descriptions.
4) Car Scanner allows you to read free-frames (sensors state when DTC is saved).
5) Now with Mode 06 - you can get ECU self-monitoring test results. Helps you fix your car and helps keep repair costs down!
6) Check if your car is ready for emission tests.
7) Check all of the sensors at one screen
8) Car Scanner works with any vehicle that uses the OBD 2 standard (most vehicles built after 2000, but can work for vehicles as far back as 1996, check carscanner.info for more details). 
9) Car Scanner includes a lot of connection profiles, that gives you some extra features for Toyota, Mitsubishi, GM, Opel, Vauxhal, Chevrolet, Nissan, Infinity, Renault, Dacia, Hyundai, Kia, Mazda, Volkswagen, Audi, Skoda, Seat, BMW and many others.
10) Car Scanner dashboard includes a HUD mode, that you can use to project data to your windshield.
11) Car Scanner provides a tool for very accurate acceleration measurments (0-60, 0-100, etc.)
12) Car Scanner can be used as a trip computer and can show you fuel consumption statistics!
13) For cars of the VAG group (Volkswagen, Audi, Skoda, Seat), built on the MQB and PQ26 platforms, encoding functions are available - setting hidden parameters of the car.
14) And one more thing - Car Scanner provides the widest variety of features for FREE across the App Store.

The app requires a Wi-Fi or or Bluetooth 4.0 (Bluetooth LE) OBD2 ELM327 compatible adapter (device) to work. ELM327 devices plugs into the diagnostics socket in the car ang gives your phone access to car diagnostics.
Recommended adapters brands: Kiwi 3, Viecar, V-Gate, Carista, LELink, Veepeak.
If you buy one of the cheap china OBD2 ELM327 adapters from ebay / amazon, then make sure it’s not marked as v.2.1. This adapters are supported, but they have lot’s of bugs.
PLEASE NOTE: Vehicle ECUs vary in the amount of sensors supported. This app can’t show you something, that is not provided by your car.

Attention "bad" adapters! We faced the problem, that some adapters (often cheep Chinese clones), can’t connect to the smartphone or the car. Some of them can even make your car engine work unstable, often lost connection, increase time lag when reading data.
So, we recommend you to use genuine ELM327 or recommended adapter brands.

Car Scanner ELM OBD2 is free but to unlock all the features, a one-time purchase or a subscription is required. 

Under no circumstances will the developer of this application be held responsible for incidents resulting from the use and/or interpretation of the data in the application.

If you have any issues, you can always contact developer using Settings - Contact developer in the app or just send email to wp_soft@outlook.com

Car Scanner ELM OBD2 for iOS Terms of use can be found at https://www.carscanner.info/ios-tos/

it.name: Alarm Clock for Me - Wake Up!
it.d:
Wake up and go to sleep to your favorite music, never sleep through your alarm again, get your own collection of exclusive designer clocks, know weather conditions in your area, cook or work out with a multifunctional timer, and light up the darkness with a powerful built-in flashlight!

FEATURES: 
 
* Choose from stylish designer themes for the clock: Digital (Blue, Green, Red, and Yellow), Ultrasonic (Blue, Green, Red, and Yellow), Wordy, ThinLine
* Create your own wake-up playlist with the best music  
* Background alarm support: alarm will ring even if the app is not running 
* Choose a way to stop the alarm: shake your device or solve a math problem
* Go to sleep to your favorite songs or white noise 
* Check live weather conditions and temperature 
* Change the screen brightness so that it doesn’t blind you after a good night’s sleep 
* Shake your device or double tap on the screen to switch on the flashlight 
* Convenient app settings. Get easy access to any option you need. 

Alarm Clock for Me provides the functionality of 6 indispensable apps in 1: 

ALARM 
- Wake up to your favorite music 
- Shake your device or solve a math problem to turn off the alarm
- Set multiple alarms with different tunes 
- Background alarm support: alarm will go off even if the app is not running! 
- Easy access to the nearest alarm from the main screen 
- Huge Snooze/Stop alarm buttons 
- Add your notes to the alarm! 
- Adjustable volume of Sounds/Music 
- Vibrate / Fade in / Snooze options 
- Shake-to-snooze when alarm goes off 

CLOCK 
- Exclusive designer clocks 
- Vertical and horizontal modes 
- 12 or 24 time format 
- Show/Hide seconds 
- Show/Hide day of the week 
- Auto-Lock when plugged in ON/OFF 
- Auto-Lock when on battery ON/OFF 
- Customizable auto-lock time 

SLEEP TIMER
- Use the shortcut on the main screen to go directly to the sleep timer settings 
- Create your own playlist with your favorite songs 
- Shuffle music ON/OFF 
- Adjust the volume of Music/Sounds 
- Go to sleep to white noise 

WEATHER 
- Check live weather conditions and temperature 
- Automatic detection of your current location and weather conditions display in your area 
- Weather conditions and temperature in any location you choose 
- Temperature unit: Fahrenheit/Celsius 
- Show Weather ON/OFF 

COUNTDOWN
- Never miss important events and special occasions. Count down to your vacation, anniversary, graduation and more

FLASHLIGHT
- Shake your device or double tap on the screen to switch on the flashlight

TIMER
- No matter whether you are cooking or working out, multifunctional timer will always be at hand!

Beautiful. Reliable. Versatile. Get the alarm clock that you've been looking for!

For complete access to all Alarm Clock for Me features, you will need to allow access to the following: 

*Notifications – otherwise, alarm will not ring;
*[OPTIONAL] Location data to provide you with the weather forecast for your exact location;
*[OPTIONAL] Media library so that you can set your own music as an alarm or a sleep timer sound;
*[OPTIONAL] Camera to activate a powerful built-in flashlight;
*[OPTIONAL] Photos to give you a possibility to set them as countdown pictures.

it.name: Device Monitor²

Device Monitor² is a one-of-a-kind app designed for iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Mac, providing all the essential information about your device at a glance, quickly and effortlessly. Discover which sensors apps have access to and take control of your privacy.  

Why choose Device Monitor²?  
Here are some of its main features:  
• Clear and intuitive data visualization;
• Detailed information about:  
   - DEVICE,  
   - SENSORS,  
   - RAM,  
   - STORAGE,  
   - CPU,  
   - GPU,  
   - NETWORK,  
   - BATTERY,  
   - DISPLAY,  
   - CAMERA.  
• Shortcuts to the Shortcuts app;
• Shortcuts to the Control Center (requires iOS 18);
• Customizable widgets for StandBy Mode, Lock Screen and the Home Screen;
• Options to hide or reorder panels according to your needs;
• App icon customization.  

Unlock advanced features with additional packs:  
• PRO Kit:  
   - Access to all features of other in-app purchases (present and future);
   - Deep memory cleaning;
   - Support for opening .synced files;
   - Copy and paste data displayed in the app.
• PiP Kit:
   - Access to Picture-in-Picture mode (both “compact” and “extended” modes) for real-time monitoring of:
       → RAM,
       → CPU,
       → NETWORK.
• Test Kit:  
   - Complete testing of device sensors, including:  
       → GPS,  
       → Compass,  
       → Altimeter,  
       → Accelerometer,  
       → Shake,
       → Magnetometer,  
       → Gyroscope,  
       → Barometer,  
       → Device Motion,  
       → Motion Coprocessor,  
       → Pedometer,  
       → Bluetooth,  
       → iBeacon,  
       → Microphone,  
       → Volume,  
       → Speakers,  
       → Proximity Sensor,  
       → NFC,  
       → Touch ID,  
       → Vibration and Haptic Feedback,  
       → Ping,  
       → Traceroute,  
       → DNS Lookup,  
       → Acid3,  
       → Speed Test,  
       → Network Device Scanner,  
       → Brightness,  
       → Multi-touch,  
       → Screen Color,  
       → Camera,  
       → Flash.  
• Report Kit:  
   - Export data displayed in the app as a PDF, CSV, XLSX or RFT document.  
• Notification Kit:  
   - Customizable notifications for:  
       → RAM usage exceeding limits,
       → Device temperature reaching abnormal levels.  
• Ads Kit:  
   - Remove ads from the app.  


The app does not collect any personal data or even non-personal data. Why? Simple: We’re not interested!
Oh, and don’t forget: the app is FREE!

it.name: Night Sky
it.d:
Night Sky is a powerful AI personal planetarium.

Quickly identify stars, planets, constellations and satellites above by simply holding your iPhone, iPad or Apple Watch to the Night Sky!  This is all done magically.  Whether you’re looking for a constellation, or the International Space Station, let Night Sky direct you to it, then explore the object in AR!

FEATURE SET: 

- NIGHT SKY + AURA (Night Sky + Aura Subscription required) - Your Personal AI Super Astronomer!  Ask Night Sky Aura virtually anything about Space and it will know the answer.  Night Sky Aura fully interfaces with features within Night Sky, to direct you to objects you’re interested in, provide information on anything to do with astronomy, or even show you how the sky looks on the other side of the world!  With your own personal AI Super Astronomer right by your side, Night Sky Aura becomes the new natural way to interact with the sky above! 

- SKY TAGS - Make Night Sky yours, by adding personal Sky Tags to the map!  Pin Sky Tags to objects in the sky to save for future reference, and share them via iMessage so others can find them!  Sky Tags can be categorized, and are completely personal to you.  Maybe you want to tag a star as a memorial to someone, or tag something you’d like to observe later that night.  You can even add Astrophotography photos and observation notes to your Sky Tags!  

- CONNECTED STARGAZING (+ Feature) - Connected Stargazing is a revolutionary new feature that utilizes SharePlay in iOS 15.1, allowing you to stargaze with others when you are apart!  Start a FaceTime Audio call with those who you would like to stargaze with, then create a session by adding objects for everyone to find in the sky!

- SPATIAL AUDIO OBJECT NAVIGATION - Using AirPods Pro or AirPods Max, search for an object when automatic sky tracking is on, and Night Sky will make the star, planet or constellation ‘chirp’ in the 360° soundscape, assisting you to navigate to the object with sound!

- AR SKY WINDOW - Erase the ceiling of your bedroom, lounge or classroom with AR!  Night Sky intelligently detects the ceiling or other flat surface in a room, and can make it magically disappear to reveal the sky behind it!  

- BILLIONS OF STARS!  (+ Feature) - Space is vast, so Night Sky has been hyper charged with over 1.7 BILLION STARS streamed from the cloud!  With a new super deep zoom (greater than 10X before), prepare to delve deeper into space than you ever imagined!

- MAPS UI - A clean and familiar interface with Search features including Quick Find, intelligent Night Red Mode, Light Pollution indicator and easy to use menu, prepare to navigate Night Sky quicker than ever before!

- AR PLANETARY PORTALS & AR GRAND ORRERY (+ Features) - Step onto the surface of other planets by placing AR portals around your room!  Or walk around the entire Solar System using the newly refreshed interactive Grand Orrery!

- NIGHT SKY WATCH AR - Night Sky magically comes to life on Apple Watch, with Glass Constellations, Red Vision, and Night Sky Live Tours - all on your wrist! 

- AR OBJECT EXPLORATION  - Pull Planets, Stars and Constellations out of the sky and look at them in detailed AR!

- NIGHT SKY TOURS (+ Feature):  Get a live sky tour or create your own sky tours for any location and time in the world!  

- NIGHT SKY MINDFULNESS (+ Feature) - A mindfulness stargazing experience adding mindfulness minutes with Apple HealthKit. 

- AND MANY MORE FEATURES! 


Subscription Information: 'Night Sky +' and 'Night Sky + Aura' are available as optional subscriptions. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings. it.name: Noir - Dark Mode for Safari
it.d:
Noir is a Safari extension that automatically adds a dark mode to every website you visit.

It makes browsing the web at night so much better. With Noir, you won’t be blinded by bright websites ever again.

And the results look great too. Noir generates a custom dark style for each website you visit, based on the colors that are used on a page. You won’t even notice this happening in the background – that’s how fast it is – but you’ll certainly appreciate the end result: a beautiful dark mode tailored for each website, where contrast is preserved and highlights still pop. And with over 20 built-in themes and the ability to create your own, you can customize the results exactly the way you want.

Noir works with any website you visit in Safari, automatically. By default, Noir is linked to your device’s Dark Mode, so websites will only go dark when you want them to. It supports the brand new Safari web extension feature, which means there’s no need to manually activate it every time you load a new page. The app also tightly integrates with system features such as Shortcuts, Control Center, Focus Filters, and Widgets to fully integrate Noir in all your workflows. And your settings are automatically synced to all your devices using iCloud.

And just as importantly, Noir takes your privacy seriously: it doesn’t collect any of your browsing data. Period.

Noir is made by an indie iOS developer. It does not include any subscriptions or ads. Buy Noir once, use it forever.

Notes:

Privacy Policy:
• The Noir extension requires access to the websites you visit to analyze the existing style of the page and to override it with Noir's dark style.
• Noir never collects your browsing data. The only data Noir ‘collects’ are your settings, and those will never leave your device or iCloud account.
• You can read Noir’s full Privacy Policy at https://getnoir.app/privacypolicy

it.name: Screen Mirroring to TV: DoCast
it.d:
DoCast is a great screen mirroring app for iPhone and iPad that allows you to mirror screen to any Smart TV in high quality with no delay. 

Seamlessly mirror, connect iPhone to Smart TV, and easily stream any media content, whether it's music, videos, or photos.

How to screen mirror iPhone to Smart TV:

1. Open DoCast and select your device from the list of available.
2. Press the "Screen" button on the main screen of DoCast to start screen mirroring.
3. Configure the settings with which mirroring will occur and tap the "Start mirroring" button.
4. Tap the "Stop mirroring" button on the DoCast screen to stop screen mirroring.

If you want to cast from iPhone to TV, simply tap the corresponding button - Videos, Photos, or Music - on the main screen of DoCast, and choose the content you want to stream.

Note: While streaming/mirroring, make sure that your iPhone/iPad is connected to the same router and Wi-Fi network as the cast device.

Key Features of DoCast:

- Screen share iPhone to TV with exceptional picture quality, and extend your experience by casting iPhone to any Smart TV or streaming device.
- Take control of your viewing experience with adjustable video quality settings and auto-rotation, ensuring everything looks just right.
- Enjoy low-latency screen mirroring with delays lower than one second when on a robust Wi-Fi connection, providing real-time interaction.
- Cast iPhone to TV, stream unlimited photos for free from your device's library, and enjoy your favorite videos and music on your Smart TV or speakers.

Note: The screen mirroring feature is available only in the paid version of the app. In the free version of DoCast, there are no limits for photo casting, music sessions last up to 15 minutes, and video sessions are limited to 3 minutes.

Broad Compatibility:

DoCast seamlessly connects your iPhone or iPad to a variety of devices, including:
Smart TVs: Samsung TV, LG TV, Sony TV, Hisense TV, Panasonic TV, and other DLNA-enabled TVs.
Roku Devices: Roku Streaming Players and Roku TVs (TCL, Hisense, Sharp, Philips, etc.)
Chromecast Family: All generations, including TVs with Chromecast built-in (Sony, Vizio, Hisense, Sharp) and Google TV Streamer.
Fire TV devices: TVs with in-built Fire TV, including Insignia, Toshiba, and Amazon Fire TV Smart TVs.
Other Devices: Xiaomi Mi Box, Nvidia Shield TV, and other Android TV boxes.

Terms of Use and Privacy Policy: https://www.electronic.us/company/policies/docast/ 

Disclaimer: This app is not affiliated with Google, Amazon, Roku, or any other trademarks mentioned.

Note: Screen Mirroring iPhone to TV with DoCast won't work for copyrighted content from platforms such as Apple TV+, Apple Fitness+, Netflix, Amazon Prime, and more due to streaming service restrictions. Also, the app will see available Apple Music tracks, but won’t be able to play some of them due to DRM protection or if they're in the cloud. These are the limitations of services, not the DoCast app.

it.name: Remote Mouse
it.d:
Remote Mouse™ turns your mobile device into a powerful remote control app for your PC or Mac. Use your phone or tablet as a wireless mouse, keyboard, and touchpad — complete with multi-touch gestures and media controls. Whether you're watching movies, controlling a presentation, or browsing the web from your couch, Remote Mouse™ offers an effortless way to control your computer remotely.

With over 20 million users and featured by CNET, Mashable, and Product Hunt, Remote Mouse™ offers one of the most elegant solutions to computer control from mobile.

What you can do:

Mouse  
• Control the cursor like a real PC mouse  
• Move using your phone’s gyroscope (Gyro Mouse)  
• Left-handed mode support

Keyboard  
• Type remotely in any language  
• Use voice input (if supported by your soft keyboard)
• Send system and app shortcuts
• Adaptive layouts for Mac or PC  
• Use your phone as a remote keyboard for your computer

Touchpad  
• Simulates Apple Magic Trackpad  
• Supports multi-touch gestures  
• Ideal wireless touchpad app for remote navigation

Specialty Panels  
• Media Remote: Control videos, music, and presentations across apps and sites like YouTube, Netflix, Disney+, Apple TV+, VLC, Spotify, and more.  
• Browser Remote: Navigate Chrome, Firefox, and Opera  
• App Switcher: Launch and switch between apps  
• Power Options: Shut down, sleep, or restart remotely  
• Clipboard Sync: Copy and paste text/images across devices

Other features  
• Control volume using physical phone buttons  
• Secure the connection with a password  
• Reorder specialty panels  
• Customize your remote with personal wallpapers

Connection & Compatibility
• Connect over Wi-Fi or Bluetooth
• Connect by IP address, QR code, or connection history
• Supports Windows, macOS, and Linux

Easy to set up:
1. Download and install Remote Mouse for desktop on your computer: [https://remotemouse.net](https://remotemouse.net)
2. Launch the desktop version (it runs in the background)
3. Connect your mobile device to your computer via Wi-Fi or Bluetooth
