it.name: SimplePi for Raspberry Pi
it.d:
SimplePi is the Swiss army knife utility app for monitoring, controlling, and managing your Raspberry Pi using your iPhone and iPad.

MONITOR ACTIVITY
See what is going on with your Raspberry Pi. CPU, Memory, Temperature, Disk Usage, and Clock activity are shown in beautiful and easily understandable graphs.

CONTROL
Run commands on your Pi with a single tap. Want to have your own commands? No problem. SimplePi lets you add as many commands as you wish.
Additionally, you can manage your commands in groups.

TERMINAL SHELL
Access your Pi from a shell terminal with colored output and hardware keyboard support. The on-screen keyboard comes with fast access to commonly used special keys like ctrl and arrow keys.

WIDGETS
Monitor your Pi and run commands right from the Home Screen with various widgets.

VIEW COMMAND RESULTS
View and export command results and logs automatically. The results history allows you to view the results of previous commands.

DETAILED STATS
Detailed Stats for CPU and Memory give you an insight on which processes are running, how much memory is active, and much more.

FILE BROWSER
Browse Files and Folders in a file browser-like experience. 
View and export files of various formats.

MANAGE MULTIPLE PI
SimplePi can manage multiple Raspberry Pi. Configure each Raspberry Pi and connect to them simultaneously.

KEY AUTHENTICATION
Public Key authentication gives you the flexibility to authenticate in your preferred way.
Key files can be imported via iTunes or from other apps.

ICLOUD SYNC
Sync Commands, Hosts, Keys over iCloud

APP LOCK
Lock the app using FaceID, TouchID, or a custom passcode

HOME SCREEN WIDGETS
Run commands directly from your Home Screen on iOS 14

Siri Shortcuts
Integrate commands into automated worflows using the Shortcuts app (requires iOS14 or later)


NOTE: SSH needs to be enabled on your Raspberry Pi for SimplePi to work correctly.

SimplePi has been tested with the latest releases of

* Raspberry Pi OS (formerly Raspbian)
* Raspbmc
* OpenElec
* Xbian
* Pidora
* Arch Linux

SimplePi works on all Raspberry Pi models.

NOTE (only for Xbian users): Automatic start of xbian-config needs to be disabled. You can do this when connecting via SSH and selecting Config > Settings > Xbian Config > NO.

There are many different configurations out there. If you encounter problems with one of the distributions above or want to have your distribution support, please contact us.

it.name: Sunset Predictions: Alpenglow
it.d:
Alpenglow helps you capture better sunrises and sunsets, not just the times, but the quality.

Whether you’re planning a photography shoot or simply don’t want to miss a great sunrise or sunset, Alpenglow tells you when it’s worth going outside.

Unlike other sunrise apps, Alpenglow combines accurate times with sunrise and sunset quality forecasts, so you know how good the light is expected to be before it happens.

Key Features
• Sunrise, Sunset, Golden Hour, Magic Hour & Blue Hour Times
• Sunrise & Sunset Quality Forecasts, showing how good the light is expected to be
• Flexible reminder alarms so you never miss a great moment
• Custom locations to plan shoots and trips anywhere in the world
• Quick date navigation with arrows or a calendar picker
• Sun direction map showing where the sun rises and sets
• Augmented reality sun path to visualize the sun’s movement
• Live Activities to count down to upcoming events
• Interactive Home Screen, Lock Screen & StandBy widgets
• Apple Watch support, including complications
• Light & Dark Mode and full Dynamic Type support

Improve the forecasts
Submit field reports after a sunrise or sunset — your reports help improve future color and quality forecasts for everyone.

Alpenglow uses its own continuously evolving forecast model, designed specifically for predicting sunrise and sunset light quality. The model improves over time as more data and real-world reports are added.

Available on all your Apple devices
Alpenglow works across iPhone, Apple Watch, Mac, Apple TV, and Vision Pro, so your forecasts are always close at hand.

Alpenglow Pro
Alpenglow is free to use, with optional Pro features for photographers and planners who want more control and foresight.

With Alpenglow Pro, you can:
• View quality forecasts up to 4 days ahead
• Get forecast notifications when sunrise or sunset quality exceeds your threshold
• Let Alpenglow automatically schedule alarms when a sunrise or sunset is worth catching
• Unlock interactive forecast widgets
• Access forecast Apple Watch complications
• Use more accurate location and elevation data, processed entirely on-device
• Quickly revisit recently searched locations
• Customize the app with accent colors and alternative app icons
• Share Pro features with Family Sharing

Privacy-first by design
Your location stays on your device and is never stored online.

Alpenglow Pro subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your App Store account settings.

desc: QuakeMate: Earthquake Alert 🧸 Min.iOS: [16.0+] 🧀 App version: [4.2.1] !upd  🪼 App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id1673737311 📮 Notes:

it.name: QuakeMate: Earthquake Alert
it.d:
QuakeMate - real-time earthquake alerts, tsunami bulletins, maps, and community reports.

Get notified the moment an earthquake strikes near you, your family, or anywhere you care about. QuakeMate combines real-time seismic data from USGS, SeismicPortal, and GSI with a worldwide community of people reporting what they actually felt - so you know what happened, how strong it was, and whether the people you love are okay.

Track earthquakes near you, monitor seismic activity in Japan, California, Turkey, Indonesia, Chile, Mexico, Italy, Nepal, New Zealand, Israel, Greece, the Philippines, and every other tectonic hotspot - or set up custom alerts for any region in the world.

KEY FEATURES

• Real-time earthquake alerts the moment a quake hits
• Critical notifications that break through Silent & Focus modes
• Official tsunami bulletins from NTWC, PTWC and GDACS - see whether a warning, watch or advisory is active, expired or cancelled, and the affected coastlines on a map
• Updates timeline on every earthquake - what the agency changed since it happened: magnitude, depth, location, review status, tsunami status, felt reports and aftershocks
• Interactive earthquake map with live epicenters and aftershocks
• Worldwide seismic feed - every recorded quake, as it happens
• Search earthquakes by city, country, region, or area
• Filter by magnitude, time range, and data source
• Full earthquake details: magnitude, depth, location, time, tsunami flag, PAGER impact assessment
• Community "Did you feel it?" reports alongside USGS Did You Feel It responses - see who else felt the same shake
• Live activity graphs around any earthquake
• Tectonic plate boundaries, volcano locations, tsunami risk zones
• Shake-intensity heat maps from community DYFI reports
• Explore hub - 110 country profiles, 15 tectonic plates, the latest tsunami bulletins worldwide, and famous places like Yellowstone and the San Andreas
• Swipeable earthquake facts and the science behind the shaking
• Breaking hazard news for every seismic region, from trusted sources
• Trusted data sources: USGS, SeismicPortal, GSI
• Earthquake safety tips and emergency preparedness info

REAL-TIME ALERTS

Set unlimited zones around the places that matter - home, work, your parents' house, your kids' school. Pick a minimum magnitude per zone. The moment a quake matches, you get a push notification. Critical alerts deliver even when your phone is silenced. Worldwide alerts can be limited to a continent or country, and any alert can also deliver official tsunami warnings, watches or advisories.

COMMUNITY REPORTS

See who else felt the same shake - and tell us what you felt. Each report includes intensity, distance from the epicenter, and time. Aggregated into live heat maps so you can see how far a quake's shaking actually reached.

QUAKEMATE PREMIUM

• Critical alerts and unlimited custom zones
• Full map layers - volcanoes, tectonic plates, tsunami risk, shake intensity, heat map
• Recent activity nearby + community reports on every earthquake
• Family Sharing - covers up to 6 family members
• Ad-free experience
• Early access to new features

WHY QUAKEMATE?

QuakeMate is built for anyone who wants a simple, clear, reliable way to track earthquakes worldwide. Use it to follow local quakes, monitor global seismic activity, check recent earthquakes near you, share confirmed reports with the community, or just stay prepared with up-to-date safety information.

Privacy-first: Sign in with Apple is the only auth path. Hide My Email is supported. We never see your real email address.

All plans include Family Sharing.

Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation. Subscriptions automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage subscriptions in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Service: https://quakemate.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://quakemate.app/privacy

it.d:
An independent browser thoughtfully designed by a single human, and funded by its users.

WHAT THE PRESS SAYS
“A very robust, exquisitely designed, stunningly handsome web browser. […] It’s just so thoughtful. So utterly modern in its appearance and features, but old-school in its hyperfocus on serving you, the user, through craftsmanship.”
— Daring Fireball

“My favorite iOS browser these days is Quiche Browser. It’s somehow both incredibly simple and one of the most customizable browsers I’ve ever tried.”
— The Verge

“Quiche Browser has clearly been designed with care.”
— MacStories 

“If you want a lightweight, private, minimalistic, yet customizable web browsing experience on your iPhone – [Quiche Browser] might be the perfect answer for you.”
— 9to5Mac 

“Quiche Browser is unique, engaging, and fully customizable.”
— Lifehacker

BROWSER CUSTOMIZATION DESIGNED TO STAY SIMPLE AND BEAUTIFUL
• Choose and place every toolbar and menu button.
• Customize the address bar’s appearance and contents.
• Choose from a list of ready-to-use toolbars, which you can then adapt to your needs.
• Use a Liquid Glass toolbar, or switch to a Classic one if Liquid Glass isn’t your thing.
• Manage tabs with multiple display and sorting options.
• Read web pages in full screen for focused, distraction-free browsing.

BUILT-IN BLOCKING
Ads, trackers, and cookie banners are blocked by default. 
Pages load faster and feel less cluttered.

DARKEN ALL WEBSITES
Pick a unique dark mode theme and apply it to every website. 
No more blinding white pages at night.

COMFORT MODE
Adjust the interface so your tabs, favorites, and search suggestions are always easy to reach with one hand.

UNIQUE QUALITY-OF-LIFE IMPROVEMENTS EVERYWHERE
• Use any search engine, even Kagi or your own SearXNG instance.
• Enhance your toolbar with a wide range of tools: disable JavaScript, switch to desktop mode, close all tabs and clear data, translate pages, and more.
• Estimated read time for every page.
• Open new tabs on the website of your choice.
• Extreme energy saving in Low Power Mode.

MY PRIVACY STANCE: KEEP YOUR DATA FOR YOURSELF
• Zero data tracking or usage monitoring.
• Never connects to any first-party or third-party servers, except to RevenueCat for managing purchases and preventing fraud.
• No sign-up, obviously.

LIGHTWEIGHT, FAST, AND ORIGINAL
Quiche Browser is not another bloated clone of Firefox, Brave, or Chrome. 
I built it entirely from scratch for performance and to keep it lightweight.

FULLY INDEPENDENT
• No investors dictating growth or influencing product direction. 
• No search engine deals, data monetization, or partner agreements shaping the browser.
• It’s just me, building the browser of my dreams.

100% FUNDED BY USERS
Subscribing to Quiche PLUS unlocks additional features such as Website Darkening, Comfort Mode, all app icons, and all button styles.

Building a web browser alone is a full-time job, and subscribing also allows me to:
• Keep the app up to date with new iOS releases and features.
• Build more unique features.
• Start working toward a macOS version.

it.name: Speak4Me Text to Speech Reader
it.d:
Speak4Me is a text to speech app that does two things: it reads aloud anything you want to listen to, and it speaks out loud anything you type. Listen to PDFs, documents, books, web articles and photos of printed pages – or type a message and let Speak4Me say it for you, in 120+ natural AI voices.

LISTEN: READ ALOUD ANYTHING

• PDF to audio – Import any PDF from Files or iCloud Drive and listen to it like an audiobook. Headers and footers are skipped automatically, so you only hear the content.
• Documents and books – Turn long documents, book chapters, study notes and reports into audio. Follow along with real-time text highlighting.
• Web articles – Listen to articles, blog posts and newsletters instead of reading them on screen.
• Scan and listen – Take a photo of a printed page, a book, a letter or a menu, and Speak4Me reads the text out loud.
• Listen anywhere – Keep listening while you commute, walk, work out or cook. Speed up the voice to get through your reading list faster.

SPEAK: TYPE TO SPEAK

• Type and Speak4Me talks for you – Write what you want to say and it is spoken out loud instantly, in the voice and language you choose.
• A voice when you need one – Made for people who have lost their voice, have a speech disability, are recovering from a stroke, or find it hard to speak in some moments. Use it to talk face to face, at the doctor, in a shop or on the phone.
• Favorite phrases – Save the sentences you use most and play them with one tap.
• AI voice-overs – Use Speak4Me as an AI voice generator and narrator: type a script and export it as an MP3 for videos, TikTok, Reels, podcasts, presentations and customer support.

NATURAL AI VOICES

• 120+ lifelike AI voices, male and female, in 20+ languages and accents.
• Ultra voices: our most human, expressive and fluid voices.
• Adjust voice speed and font size to fit the way you read.

MADE FOR EVERY READER

• Dyslexia-friendly font and text highlighting to make reading easier.
• Helpful for dyslexia, ADHD, low vision, language learners and anyone who prefers listening to reading.
• Save any audio and share it via iMessage, WhatsApp, email and more.

WHO USES SPEAK4ME

Students who listen to their notes and PDFs. Professionals who turn reports and emails into audio. Book lovers who listen to what they read. People who use their phone as a voice to communicate. Creators who need quick voice-overs.

FAQ

• Can Speak4Me read PDFs aloud? Yes. Import any PDF and listen to it like an audiobook, with headers and footers skipped.
• Can it read a printed book or document? Yes. Take a photo of the page and Speak4Me reads the text out loud.
• Can it read web articles? Yes. Listen to articles, blog posts and newsletters instead of reading them on screen.
• Can it speak for me? Yes. Type any sentence and it is spoken out loud instantly. Save the phrases you use most for one-tap access.
• Can I use it as an AAC app? Yes. Speak4Me works as a simple type-to-speak communication tool for people who can't speak or find it hard to.
• Can I create AI voice-overs? Yes. Type a script, pick one of 120+ AI voices and export it as an MP3.
• Does it help with dyslexia? Yes. It offers a dyslexia-friendly font and highlights the text as it reads.
• Can I change the reading speed? Yes. Slow it down or speed it up to fit the way you listen.
• Which languages does it support? 20+ languages and accents, including American, British and Australian English, Spanish, French, German, Chinese and Japanese.

Questions or feature requests? Write to us at support@bakeryscent.com

SUBSCRIPTION

it.name: Muslim Pro: Quran & Athan
it.d:
Muslim Pro is a prayer and Quran app built for Muslims who want to build a consistent daily prayer habit, read and listen to the Quran, and find their Qibla direction anywhere in the world. It's especially useful for people managing prayer times while traveling, students memorizing Quran, and anyone building consistency with daily prayers and fasting.

Core features
Accurate Prayer Times & Alerts: Get real-time Athan notifications calculated from your exact location, so you never miss a prayer window whether you're at home or traveling.
Al Quran: Read, Listen & Memorize: Access the complete Holy Quran with audio recitations from multiple reciters and translations in your language, plus dedicated tools for memorization and daily reflection.
Qibla Finder & Islamic Calendar: Instantly find your prayer direction using your phone's compass, and track important Islamic dates with accurate Hijri date calculation.
Prayer & Fasting Tracker: Log your five daily prayers and fasting days to build lasting consistency. Visible streaks and gently timed reminders turn a daily intention into an actual habit.
Duas & Dhikr: A curated collection of daily supplications and remembrance for specific moments (waking up, traveling, eating, difficulty), plus a built-in tasbih counter to track your dhikr, so you always have the right dua on hand.


How does Muslim Pro help me build a consistent prayer habit?
The Prayer & Fasting Tracker logs every prayer and fast automatically, builds a visible streak, and sends reminders timed to your location, so consistency becomes something you can see and reinforce every day, not just something you're aiming for. Gamified Quests add small daily rewards (Stars & Crescents) that reinforce the habit further.

Can Muslim Pro help me during Ramadan?
Yes. The app calculates accurate suhoor and iftar times based on your location, and the Prayer & Fasting Tracker lets you log each fasting day and build a streak throughout the month.

Does Muslim Pro work when I'm traveling?
Yes. Prayer times, Qibla direction, and Athan notifications update automatically based on your current location, and the Halal Restaurant & Prayer Space Finder helps you find nearby options wherever you are.

Is the Quran available offline?
Premium subscribers get offline access to Quran text and audio recitations, so you can read and listen without an internet connection.


More in the app
Halal Restaurants & Prayer Spaces Nearby: find halal eateries and prayer spots wherever you are.
Journaling: track your habit-building progress with mood tracking, picture journaling, and personal notes.
Ummah Pro: a moderated space to share duas and connect with other users.
Gamified Quests: earn Stars & Crescents for completing daily acts of practice, reinforcing your habit over time.


Muslim Pro Premium
Ad-free experience.
Offline Quran reading and audio recitation.
Customizable prayer widgets and interactive lessons.

Pricing (US): $12.99/month or $34.99/year. Pricing varies by country and is charged in local currency. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the current period ends; manage this in your Apple account settings.

Available in: English, Bahasa Indonesia, Bahasa Melayu, Français, العربية, اردو, and more.

it.name: Paku - Air Quality & AQI Map
it.d:
See the air you’re actually breathing.

Most apps give you one AQI number for your whole city. Paku shows you live readings from thousands of PurpleAir and AirGradient sensors, so you know when it’s safe to open the windows, go for a run, or send the kids outside.

→ A map of real, live sensors
Every public PurpleAir and AirGradient sensor on a fast, beautiful map, indoors and out, with AQI, temperature, humidity, and how they’re trending. Official AirNow government stations are on the map too, and a Data Sources screen lets you choose which networks you see. Smart Select picks the most reliable sensor near you, not just the closest one.

→ Widgets for every screen
Put the nearest sensor, a favorite spot, or your own sensor on your Home Screen, Lock Screen, Apple Watch, or Mac desktop. Glance, then get on with your day.

→ Alerts that beat the smoke
Set a threshold on any sensor and Paku will notify you the moment it’s crossed, then again when the air clears. Nearby alerts can even follow you, watching the closest sensor as you move, entirely on your device. If you live with wildfire smoke or winter inversions, this feature is for you.

→ Live Activities
Keep the AQI and its trend in the Dynamic Island or on your Lock Screen while smoke moves through.

→ Your own sensors
Own a PurpleAir sensor? Add your private sensors and use them everywhere: on the map, in widgets, and with alerts.

→ Siri, Spotlight, and Shortcuts
Ask Siri for the air quality nearby, check it from Spotlight, or use the AQI in automations, like turning on the air purifier when the number starts climbing.

→ On every device, in sync
iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and Mac, with a live reading in your menu bar. Favorites and settings sync over iCloud.

→ Private by design
Your location never leaves your device. No account, no tracking, no data collection.

A few things reviewers have said:

“Does one job, does it very well, and keeps getting better... I wish all software was like this.”

“Seriously impressed by this app. It’s the perfect companion to my PurpleAir outdoor sensor.”

“Ten stars.”

Paku is made by one person, not a company. No growth team, no engagement tricks, just an app I use every day and keep making better. Alerts, Live Activities, and private sensors are part of Paku Pro, a small subscription or one-time lifetime unlock that keeps everything running. The map, the widgets, and the rest are free.

it.name: WebSSH - Sysadmin Toolbox
it.d:
Whether you're on the go or at your desk, WebSSH keeps you connected — anytime, anywhere! ٩(^‿^)۶

WebSSH is a professional SSH, Mosh, SFTP, Telnet, and Port Forwarding client for iOS and macOS — now with an integrated Proxmox client. Built for developers, system administrators, and IT professionals who need reliable, secure remote access wherever they are.


CONNECT WITH CONFIDENCE

Authenticate with passwords, two-factor challenge, or keys (RSA, DSA, ED25519, PuTTY). Connections are fast and stable, with support for local port forwarding, automatic startup commands, full terminal emulation (XTERM-256COLOR, XTERM, VT100), and custom profiles — themes, fonts, colors, and keyboard shortcuts tailored to your workflow.


MANAGE FILES REMOTELY

The integrated SFTP client lets you browse directories, create, rename, upload, and download files — and edit text files directly within the app. No separate FTP client needed.


MORE THAN SSH

WebSSH also supports Mosh, Telnet, and Serial connections, making it a versatile tool across a wide range of scenarios. Mosh (mobile shell) keeps your session alive through network changes, sleep, and flaky connections — switch from Wi-Fi to cellular and pick up right where you left off. Serial connections support full configuration (baud rate, parity, stop bits, flow control), and Telnet supports both direct and interactive authentication.


PROXMOX AT YOUR FINGERTIPS

NEW: WebSSH now includes a built-in Proxmox client. Connect to one or more Proxmox servers and clusters, monitor your nodes at a glance (CPU, memory, storage), and manage your VMs and LXC containers — start, stop, reboot and migrate them right from your iPhone, iPad, or Mac.


BUILT-IN SYSADMIN TOOLKIT

Quick diagnostics without leaving the app: Ping, Traceroute, DNS Lookup, and Whois. The mashREPL feature gives you a fully local shell (ls, grep, curl, ping, tar, and more) that works even without internet access.


WHY WEBSSH?

Most SSH clients are either too basic or too bloated. WebSSH hits the sweet spot: professional-grade features, a clean mobile-first interface, and rock-solid reliability — every on-device feature unlocked with a single one-time PRO purchase, yours for life.

One app. Every protocol. Zero compromises.

Download WebSSH and keep your servers close at hand, no matter where you are.

Egern is a feature-rich and powerful networking tool, specifically designed for proxying, intercepting, and modifying network traffic.

Key features include:
· Comprehensive recording of TCP, UDP, DNS, and HTTP network traffic.
· Support for a wide range of rule types: domain, domain keywords, domain suffix, domain regular expressions, domain wildcard, geo-location, IPv4/IPv6 CIDR, URL regular expressions, logical, protocol, user-agent, rule sets, and default rules.
· Flexible policy group options: selection, automatic testing, fallback, load balancing, and external policies.
· Support for multiple proxy protocols: HTTP, SOCKS5, Shadowsocks, Trojan, Hysteria2, TUIC, Vless, and Vmess.
· Effortlessly decrypt HTTPS traffic using Man-in-the-Middle attack techniques.
· URL rewriting capabilities, allowing you to freely customize network requests.
· Highly customizable request and response header rewriting functionality.
· Versatile request and response content rewriting abilities.
· Utilize JavaScript to provide customized operations on request and response data.
· Support for local HTTP proxy server and local SOCKS5 proxy server to meet various networking needs.
· DNS forwarding rules can proxy traffic to servers that support DoH, DoT, and DoQ protocols.
· Sync configuration information across devices with iCloud, ensuring consistent network settings anywhere, anytime.

As your ultimate network management tool, Egern helps you easily navigate various network environments and achieve efficient network control and debugging. Whether you're a network security expert, developer, or simply interested in network management, Egern will become an indispensable tool. Experience the powerful features of Egern and create your own exclusive networking environment today!

it.name: Alook Browser - 8x Speed
it.d:
Alook is a minimalist yet powerful browser, built to be the best browser for iOS.

Core Features  
- Lightning-fast experience: no push notifications, no news, no ads, and millisecond-level startup.  
- Audio and video: floating playback, speed control (0.5x-16.0x), background playback, AirPlay, DLNA, mini player, single-track loop, picture-in-picture, screenshots, mirroring, long-press speed control, and more.  
- File management: manual downloads, unzip/compress (zip, rar, 7z, including encrypted archives), create/edit files, open as plain text, choose file encoding, import from Photos, move/copy files, Wi-Fi transfer, and more.  
- E-book reader: supports txt, pdf, epub, kindle, mobi, azw, azw3, azw4, prc, and pdb, with Simplified/Traditional Chinese conversion.  
- Reading mode: smart pagination, Simplified/Traditional Chinese conversion, designed for novels.  
- Image mode: batch save and image compression.  
- Ad blocker: built-in Adblock Plus with multilingual rules, third-party rules, custom ad marking, and intrusive ad blocking.  
- Custom search engines: automatically detects search boxes on webpages so you can add them quickly.  
- Translation: built-in translation for 14 languages, including full-page and selected-text translation.  
- JavaScript extensions: run custom JS code.  
- File sharing: works with iOS Files and iTunes file sharing.  
- Device support: iPhone, iPhone XS Max, iPad Pro, and cross-device sync.  
- Website settings: configure floating video, ad blocking, no-image mode, clipboard access, and JavaScript per site.  
- iPad support: Split View and drag and drop.  

Other Features  
- iCloud sync for bookmarks, custom ad rules, search engines, and plugins.  
- Private/incognito browsing.  
- Custom immersive wallpapers.  
- Next-page preloading.  
- Custom site icons.  
- BigBang text selection.  
- Handoff support.  
- Auto-refresh.  
- Pull to refresh webpages.  
- Pull down on the home page to search.  
- Custom website home page.  
- Full-page screenshots.  
- Developer tools: view source, Eruda, vConsole, Cookie management.  
- Night mode: OLED pure black mode and eye-care webpage colors.  
- No-image mode: smart no-image browsing.  
- Full-screen mode: swipe to hide the toolbar.  
- Find in page.  
- Site search with the default search engine.  
- Password manager support: 1Password, LastPass, Avast Passwords, and more.  
- QR code tools: scan, recognize QR codes in images, and generate QR codes from links.  
- Desktop/mobile site switching with custom User-Agent support.  
- Block redirects to the App Store.  
- Print and create PDFs.  
- Quickly enter URLs and open copied URLs.  
- Page-turn buttons and tap-to-turn.  
- Swipe back from anywhere.  
- View site certificates.  
- Touch ID or Face ID authentication.  
- Custom long-press shortcuts.  
- Import and export bookmarks.  
- Custom fonts, language, page swipe speed, and screen rotation lock.  

Privacy and Security  
- Data protection: account, password, and activity data are not uploaded.  
- Incognito mode: browsing history, cache, and cookies are not saved.  
- Data storage: unlike browsers that store bookmarks and data in a developer database, Alook stores bookmarks and data in the user’s private iCloud database, accessible only by the user.  

User Reviews  
- keeyang1985: Conscientious software. I like it very much, and it is worth the price. Small, fast, and free of unnecessary clutter. It is the browser I have always wanted.  
- Wen Jing: The happiness brought by a good app is hard to beat. I might have missed the best browser I have ever used. Other browsers scatter features everywhere; Alook brings them together and is excellent value for the price.  

If you have any questions before or after purchase, please contact us.  
X/Twitter: AlookBrowser  
Email: AlookApp@qq.com

AutoCC helps you add captions and subtitles to videos automatically using powerful AI. Create video captions in seconds and make your content easier to watch, understand, and share across social media platforms.

Whether you are creating videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, or other platforms, AutoCC lets you generate accurate captions and subtitles without manual typing.

Add subtitles to video instantly, edit captions easily, and export your content ready for social media.

ADD CAPTIONS TO VIDEO AUTOMATICALLY

AutoCC is an easy-to-use caption generator that converts speech into captions and subtitles. Simply upload a video and the app will automatically generate subtitles for your video.

Automatic video captions help increase watch time, improve engagement, and make videos accessible for viewers watching without sound.

AUTO SUBTITLES FOR SOCIAL MEDIA VIDEOS

Create subtitles for videos designed for social media platforms such as:

• TikTok captions
• Instagram Reels captions
• YouTube Shorts subtitles
• Facebook video captions
• online course videos
• marketing and business videos

Adding captions to videos helps viewers stay engaged and improves content accessibility.

POWERFUL CAPTION GENERATOR

AutoCC uses AI speech recognition to generate captions quickly and accurately.

With this subtitle maker you can:

• generate captions for video automatically
• create subtitles in seconds
• add subtitles to video without manual typing
• save time when editing social media videos

Perfect for creators who want fast and reliable subtitle generation.

EASY SUBTITLE EDITOR

Need to adjust your captions? AutoCC includes a built-in subtitle editor.

You can easily:

• edit captions and subtitles
• adjust subtitle timing
• fix words or punctuation
• sync subtitles with video

The caption editor gives you full control over your subtitles.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR CAPTIONS

Make your video captions match your style.

Customize subtitles by changing:

• font style
• caption size
• subtitle color
• text position
• caption layout

Create captions that look perfect for TikTok videos, Instagram Reels, or YouTube Shorts.

EXPORT VIDEOS WITH CAPTIONS

After generating subtitles, export your video with captions ready to publish.

Share your captioned videos directly to social media or save them for later editing.

Export options include high-quality video output without watermarks (premium feature).

MULTI-LANGUAGE SUBTITLES

Generate subtitles in multiple languages and make your content accessible to a global audience.

AutoCC helps creators produce captions for videos that can be understood by viewers around the world.

PERFECT FOR

• TikTok creators
• Instagram Reels video creators
• YouTube Shorts makers
• social media managers
• educators and course creators
• business and marketing videos

Anyone who wants to quickly add captions and subtitles to video content.

WHY USE VIDEO CAPTIONS?

Captions and subtitles help:

• increase video engagement
• improve viewer retention
• make videos accessible
• reach viewers watching without sound

AutoCC makes it easy to generate captions for video content in just a few taps.

it.name: Python IDE & Jupyter – Juno
it.d:
Zero-setup Python IDE that runs your code offline, an AI coding assistant, and a developer toolbox — in a first-class citizen app for iPad and iPhone.

Juno is designed to cover all your Python coding needs, supporting both Python scripts (.py) and Jupyter notebooks (.ipynb) — a document format focused on applying Python to data analysis and computational science.

FREE FEATURES

- Navigate and manage files and folders, quickly preview documents and media
- Browse and edit Jupyter notebooks in a powerful, customizable notebook editor with beautifully rendered previews — editing is free
- Write and edit code sources, scripts, JSON, XML, and other text-based formats — one versatile editor for code and text alike, with syntax highlighting
- Add quick access bookmarks for file system locations outside the app's sandbox, or simply open documents in place

PRO FEATURES

Only one thing in Juno is Pro: running code. Even that is free to try — a generous trial allowance lets you run notebooks, scripts, projects, and the REPL before you buy. After the trial, running code unlocks with a one-time Pro purchase — not a subscription.

- Run Jupyter notebooks, Python scripts, and whole projects locally with the built-in Python 3.13 interpreter and a full suite of up-to-date, preinstalled scientific and data packages — entirely offline
- Explore interactively in a Python REPL — open a standalone prompt, or drop into it after running a script or project to keep exploring what it defined
- Search the variables, functions, and imports in your session with the Object Inspector — no need to print each one
- Open any folder as a project: file tree, multiple editor tabs, run any script, with a coding assistant aware of the whole project
- Keep side outputs — Preview, Browser, Console, Object Inspector — open as side-by-side tabs in an output sidebar
- View local web servers and HTML your code produces in a built-in browser with developer debug tools
- Long-running scripts and Jupyter sessions keep going in the background
- Automate with Shortcuts and Siri: App Intents run a Python file, run Python code, or open a file — pass arguments and files, capture output, and chain actions
- Leverage powerful data analysis, machine learning and developer tools: NumPy, pandas, Matplotlib, SciPy, Scikit-learn, OpenCV, LXML, and more
- Enjoy painless package management: install any pure Python package with an intuitive package manager

AI CODING ASSISTANT

The assistant runs on your key, not ours: add your OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini API key, and requests go straight from your device to your provider. You control what you spend and share — Juno never takes a cut.

PYTHON MEETS iOS

Reach native iOS APIs straight from Python with the built-in juno modules: clipboard, Keychain, device info, location, motion sensors, contacts, reminders, photos, sound, notifications, sharing, and Bluetooth. Show native alerts and pickers, present full-screen image, video, and web previews, or call into UIKit, Foundation, and any Objective-C framework via the Objective-C bridge.

PYTHON SCRIPTS

Python scripts are plain-text Python source code files with a .py extension. Juno lets you work on these with snappy, intelligent code completion, a console with full terminal emulator support, and a built-in media viewer for code-generated images, plots, web apps, and more — executed by the embedded Python interpreter, locally on your iPhone or iPad and completely offline.

JUPYTER NOTEBOOKS

A Jupyter notebook is a versatile document format that stores live code, markdown text, plots, images, and LaTeX equations in a single .ipynb file. Notebooks keep a record of every input and output of an interactive session, embedding rich output (HTML, images, video, plots) right in the document — a perfect playground for data analysis, machine learning, and computational science, and Juno makes working with them a breeze!

it.name: SwiftServer - SSH Client
it.d:
SwiftServer is an SSH client and server monitor for iPhone, iPad, and Mac. It is for developers, sysadmins, and homelab owners who run Linux, macOS, or Windows servers and want a terminal, live status, Docker, and SFTP in one app.

Nothing is installed on the server. SwiftServer connects over the SSH access you already have. No agent, no daemon, no account.

MONITORING
- CPU per core, load averages, and temperature
- Memory as used, cached, free, and swap
- Live process table, sortable and searchable
- Network speed and totals, with vnStat history by hour, day, month, and year
- Storage per volume with disk I/O speed, latency, and IOPS
- NVIDIA GPU: utilization, memory, fan, temperature, power, and compute processes
- Public IP and location per server. Global View maps every server with live latency.
- Linux, macOS, and Windows on one dashboard
- Widgets, Live Activities, and the Dynamic Island

TERMINAL
- SSH and Mosh sessions. Mosh keeps the shell alive through network changes and sleep.
- Keyboard bar with Esc, Tab, Ctrl, Alt, arrows, and ^C on iPhone and iPad. Hardware keyboards work too.
- Snippets: save a command once, run it in any session, or across many machines with a result per machine
- 518 color themes with separate light and dark picks, nine bundled monospace fonts, and custom font import
- Mac: Local Shell opens a terminal on your own Mac in the same window

DOCKER
- Speaks the Docker Engine API over the SSH connection. No Docker port is exposed.
- Overview: engine status, counts, reclaimable space, and live CPU and memory across containers
- Containers: logs, processes, inspect. Create, start, stop, restart, pause, kill, remove.
- Compose projects: up, down, start, stop, restart, pull, and logs
- Images: pull with progress, remove, prune. Volumes and networks: inspect, remove, prune. Live event stream.

SFTP
- Browse, upload, download, rename, delete, and create files and folders
- Copy files from one server to another without routing them through your device
- Quick Look preview and a text editor with save

NETWORKING
- Port forwarding: local, remote, and dynamic SOCKS rules with auto start and a built-in browser on iPhone and iPad
- Jump hosts: reach machines behind a bastion through one hop or a chain, each with its own credentials and host key check
- Connection proxies: SOCKS5 and HTTP CONNECT profiles, per machine or per forwarding rule

KEYS AND SECURITY
- Password, SSH key, and keyboard-interactive login, including two-factor prompts
- Generate Ed25519, ECDSA, or RSA keys on the device, or import existing keys
- Host key fingerprint on first contact. A changed host key stops the connection.
- Secrets stay in the device Keychain, behind Face ID, Touch ID, or passcode if you choose
- Built on Traversio, our open-source SSH engine written in Swift

ICLOUD SYNC AND PRIVACY
- Machines, identities, keys, snippets, forwarding rules, proxy profiles, and trusted host keys sync through your own iCloud. Passwords and private keys go only through iCloud Keychain, end-to-end encrypted.
- No accounts and no SwiftServer servers. What you save stays on your devices and in your iCloud.
- The only outbound request is the IP lookup, sent from your server to ipinfo.io. The result is stored on your device only.

FREE AND PREMIUM
The core of SwiftServer is free: saved machines and keys, live server status, the full terminal with Mosh and snippets, SFTP, port forwarding, Docker browsing, widgets, and Global View.
Premium adds unlimited monitored servers, iCloud sync, unlimited forwarding sessions, jump hosts, proxies, Docker management, terminal themes and fonts, SFTP preview and editing, and city, organization, and map pin for IP location. Premium is a monthly or yearly subscription, each with a free trial, or a one-time lifetime purchase. One purchase covers iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

Privacy Policy: https://swiftserver.app/privacy

it.name: CARROT Weather: Alerts & Radar
it.d:
CARROT Weather is a crazy-powerful (and privacy-conscious) weather app that delivers hilariously twisted forecasts. 

** Winner of Apple's App of the Year, Apple Design Award, and App Store Editors' Choice. Featured by The New York Times, Good Morning America, CNN, Wired, & more! ** 

Overflowing With Personality
Choose one of five personalities for CARROT, from the straitlaced “professional” to the profanity-laden “overkill.” You’ll actually be looking forward to a torrential downpour just to see what your weather robot has in store for you!

Accurate & Detailed
CARROT’s super accurate weather data gives you lightning-quick access to your current, hourly, and daily forecasts. And the easy-to-read details screens are just dripping with with meteorological goodness. 

Privacy First
Your personal information, including your location data, will never be sold to third parties.

More Than A Weather App
Complete activities to strengthen your relationship with the homicidal A.I. Follow clues to track down 150+ secret locations. Unlock 80+ achievements. Film your own TV-news-style weather report videos. Or use Augmented Reality Mode to bring CARROT right into your living room.

Join Premium Club to unlock:

- More weather data sources, including The Weather Channel, AccuWeather, and Apple Weather
- Notifications, including precipitation, weather alerts, and lightning strikes (where available)
- Lock & Home Screen widgets 
- Live Activities
- Apple Watch complications and background updates 
- Weather maps with next-hour radar, individual radar stations, and many different layers (where available)
- Customization of the entire user interface
- CarPlay app
- And so much more!

Don’t make CARROT angry. Download her now!

---

CARROT Weather uses auto-renewing subscriptions. 

Premium provides additional features like weather data sources, notifications, customization, widgets, and Apple Watch complications.

Premium Ultra includes all the features of Premium, plus rain, lightning, and storm cell notifications (where available), a CarPlay app, super-res radar, a weather maps widget, multi-model forecasts, and quick data source switching.

Premium Family includes all the features of Premium Ultra, with the added benefit of being shareable with up to five family members via Apple’s Family Sharing service. 

Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase. The subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your App Store account settings after purchase. Cancellation of the current active subscription period is not allowed.

Terms of Use: http://support.meetcarrot.com/weather/terms.html
Privacy Policy: http://support.meetcarrot.com/weather/privacypolicy.html

it.name: Decibel X:dB Sound Level Meter
it.d:
"Decibel X" is one of very few noise meter apps on the market that has highly reliable, pre-calibrated measurements and supports dBA, dBC. It turns your iOS device into a professional sound level meter, precisely measures the sound pressure level (SPL) all around you. This extremely useful and beautiful tool will not only be a great tool for many uses but also bring you a lot of fun. Have you wondered how quiet is your room or how loud is a rock concert or sport event? "Decibel X" will help you answer all of those.

WHAT MAKE IT GREAT AND STAND OUT FROM OTHER APPS:

- Trusted accuracy: the app is tested and pre calibrated for all Apple devices. The precision is matching with real SPL devices
- Apple Watch support: see noise level right from your wrist
- Health App integration: export noise levels directly into Health app
- Frequency weighting filters: ITU-R 468, A, B, C, Z
- Powerful, smart history data management:
  + Recording data can be saved into a list of history records for future access and analysis
  + Each record can be exported as hi-res PNG graph or CSV text via sharing services
  + iCloud support which synchronize all history records across your Apple devices
  + Fullscreen mode to give overview the whole history of an record
- Dosimeter with NIOSH, OSHA standards
- Powerful calibration: Linear, Octave 1/1, 1/3, Load/save profile
- FFT and BAR graphs to display real time FFT. Those are very useful for frequency analysis and musical tests. Real time predominant frequency is also displayed.
- InstaDecibel to capture your dB report overlaid on photos and easily shared via popular social networks (Facebook, Instagram, Messages, etc.).
- Support Live Activity, Dynamic Island
- Support both Portrait and Landscape layouts
- Beautiful, intuitive and carefully crafted UI design. Themes: LIGHT, DARK and CLASSIC

OTHER GREAT FEATURES:

- Standard time weightings (Response Time): SLOW (500 milliseconds), FAST (200 milliseconds) AND IMPULSE (50 milliseconds)
- MIC Gain Offset from -50 dB to 50 dB
- Standard measurement range from 30 dBA up to 130 dBA
- HISTO graph for plotted history of the recorded values
- WAVE graph with 2 display modes: Rolling & Buffer
- SPECTROGRAPH
- Real time scale level chart
- Display Current, Average/Leq, and Max values with both nice and clear digital and analog layouts
- Quick reference text to help you compare with real-life examples

NOTES:

- Please do not expect a quiet room reading will be 0 dBA. The range 30-130 dBA is the standard usable range and an average quiet room will be about 30 dBA.
- Although all devices are pre-calibrated, custom calibration is suggested for serious purposes requiring higher precision and accuracy. You will need a real external device or calibrated sound meter as a reference, then adjust the trimming calibration until the reading matches with the reference.

* Privacy Policy: http://www.skypaw.com/decibelx/privacy_policy.html
* EULA: http://www.skypaw.com/decibelx/terms.html

it.d:
What can iFont do?
iFont lets you install new fonts for use in apps which support creating content using custom fonts, such as Pages, Keynote or Numbers.

What can't iFont do?
iFont can't change the system font; work with the keyboard; or force apps to let you customise the font. iFont also can't make Comic Sans look good.

***
“Without iFont, writing my new book, ‘Ten Seconds To Consider’, would be an impossible task, given that I'm designing as I write. For my Pages documents to be consistent between macOS and iOS now is a game changer. Thank you for iFont!” — Daniel Klein, former Apple employee
***

iFont includes a wide range of features which let you install, compare, and view typefaces, including individual glyphs and technical details. These include:

CUSTOM FONTS
Install your own fonts (.ttf, .ttc, .otf formats supported, as well as these formats compressed in a .zip) for use in other apps. Simply download a font in a web browser, open in iFont and follow the simple instructions to install it on your device. You can also export a copy of the font, or send the profile to a friend to let them install it, too. iFont can also open archives containing multiple fonts.

FONT DOWNLOADS
iFont lets you download and install a range of fonts from the Google Fonts library, Dafont and more (including custom sources) within the app. It couldn’t be easier to find a suitable typeface for your next leaflet, poster or financial report.

***
After discovering iFont a couple of years ago it has slotted happily into my professional workflow on the iPad Pro. It has a number of standout features which set it apart from the competition, and has been a great help in my client project work. 

There’s also an appreciation of type heritage and design, with biographical information and rich technical detail on hand. Choosing the right type is made easier with the Notepad and Compare features. The ability to install multiple fonts at once is essential, saving time and allowing better management of your font library. Imported fonts are viewed as families allowing you to easily compare different weights and make the right choices. There’s also easy access to online type resources such as Google Fonts, which makes finding and installing them a breeze. Great if you’re in a hurry, or have no access to your own font library. — Martin Cleave, creative professional
***

COMPARE
Compare many different typefaces to see which will suit your intended use. Arial or Helvetica? Zapfino, Snell Roundhand or Savoye LET? Georgia, Iowan Old Style or Times New Roman? With Compare, you can be the judge!

NOTEPAD
The Notepad you find under each font lets you test it out and type a message, and then export it as an image to send in apps such as Messages. Add some character to your texts by using a font which stands out from the crowd!

WATERFALL
See how a font looks at very small or very large point sizes easily using the Waterfall view. This lets you judge which size would be suitable for your use.

ZOOM
Zoom into a font up to 500%, allowing you to see the minute details in each character.

TECHNICAL DETAILS
See information about each font, from the designer and trademark information to the spacing of the ascents and descents.

***
“Missing fonts on iOS is an issue of the past, thanks to apps like iFont… I hope you saw how easy it is to install fonts on iPhone or iPad and I suggest you give iFont a try.” — Michael Kummer, blogger
***

NOTE: iFont does not currently support .suit or .dfont files.

iFont is also fully optimised for iPad with a beautiful split view experience and a range of keyboard shortcuts.

AI PET CARE ASSISTANT

Ask PetNoter AI about pet care, common health topics, medications, nutrition, symptoms, and more. Get helpful AI-powered information and guidance to help you make informed decisions about your pet's care.

AI Pet Care Assistant is available with Pro.

PET HEALTH RECORDS

Keep your pet's important health information organized in one place.

* Vaccination records
* Medication history
* Veterinary records
* Microchip information
* Health notes
* Insurance documents
* Important pet documents

Quickly access your pet's health history whenever you need it.

VACCINATION AND MEDICATION REMINDERS

Stay on top of your pet's healthcare routine with customizable reminders.

Never forget important vaccinations, booster shots, medications, flea and tick treatments, deworming, vet appointments, and recurring care.

PET WEIGHT AND GROWTH TRACKER

Track your pet's weight and growth over time with easy-to-understand charts.

Monitor puppies, kittens, adult dogs, cats, rabbits, and other pets and keep a history you can reference during veterinary visits.

VET AND VETERINARY RECORDS

Keep your pet's veterinary information organized and easy to access.

Record vet visits, treatments, medications, vaccinations, health information, and notes in your pet's profile.

PET HEALTH REPORTS

Create a comprehensive pet health report and export it as a PDF.

Useful for veterinary visits, travel, boarding, pet sitters, or when visiting a new veterinarian.

PET EXPENSE TRACKER

Keep track of your pet care expenses, including:

* Vet visits
* Medications
* Food
* Grooming
* Vaccinations
* Pet supplies
* Other pet expenses

DOG AND PUPPY TRACKER

Manage your dog's health and care in one place. Track vaccinations, medications, weight, veterinary records, reminders, expenses, documents, and more.

CAT AND KITTEN TRACKER

Organize your cat's health information, vaccinations, medications, weight, vet records, reminders, expenses, and documents.

FOR MORE THAN DOGS AND CATS

PetNoter supports many types of pets, including:

* Dogs
* Cats
* Rabbits
* Birds
* Hamsters
* Reptiles
* Other pets

MADE FOR MULTI-PET FAMILIES

Create individual profiles for every pet and keep their health records, medications, reminders, weight history, documents, expenses, and notes organized separately.

FREE TO DOWNLOAD

Start organizing your pet's health and care with PetNoter.

PetNoter is a pet health tracker with veterinary records, vaccination and medication reminders, weight tracking, pet care tools, and AI assistance in one app.

it.name: Screenshot PRO Screenshots App
it.d:
THE BEST APP FOR MANAGING YOUR SCREENSHOTS

Do you save many screenshots for work or to avoid forgetting something you saw on your device? Do you have the photo album on your phone full of screens that you can never find quickly?

Screenshot PRO lets you better manage your screenshots:

- Search the text inside your screenshots: thanks to the Artificial Intelligence features, Screenshot PRO analyzes your screenshots and makes all the words that appear on the screen searchable (works only for Latin languages, doesn't work for Chinese, Arabic o Russian Languages)

- Export the text contained in all the screenshots: from today you can easily export the text contained in your screenshots to send it to whomever you want by simply copying it and pasting it on Whatsapp, Mail or any other application (works only for Latin languages)

- Tag any content: divide your screenshots into categories using tags to find them immediately thanks to the "explore" feature or search for them using the "search" function.

- Access your screenshots from every device thanks to iCloud sync (iOS 15 only)

- Save your favorite screenshots to access them in a moment

- Reduce the size of your screenshots to take up less space on your device

- Add notes and links: for each screenshot you can attach a textual note and a link to further increase the information and to be able to search more easily with the "search" function.

- Protect your screenshots: set a code or unlock using Face-ID or Touch-ID to protect your secret screens

- Automatic import: at every startup Screenshot PRO automatically imports all your screenshots to start managing them at best.

- Clean your camera roll: your screenshots are precious but also take up space between your personal photos. With Screenshot PRO, if you wish, your screenshots will be automatically deleted from your camera roll to avoid wasting valuable space.

Other features:
- Light and Dark mode: choose if you like more light or dark application
- iMessage integration: quickly share your screenshots with iMessage
- Multiple selection: delete or share multiple screenshots at once

All contents imported on Screenshot PRO are saved exclusively on your iPhone or iPad and not on Cloud or other servers so no one will ever be able to access your content, not even those who have developed the application.

We created this application because we felt the need for it since we lacked an app that would help us manage all the screenshots we do :)

We hope it is also useful to you and we await your feedback to constantly improve Screenshot PRO. If you have any suggestions or feedback, write to us at feedback@beatcode.it

it.name: Temp Mail - Tmailor
it.d:
Temp Mail by Tmailor.com is a fast, secure, and anonymous temporary email app that lets you receive emails instantly without using your personal email address.

Use a disposable email for sign-ups, verification codes (OTP), and one-time registrations while keeping your real inbox private and free from spam.

WHY USERS CHOOSE TEMP MAIL BY TMAILOR

• Get a temporary email address instantly without registration
• Protect your personal email and reduce spam
• Receive OTP and verification emails quickly
• Restore and reuse previously created email addresses with an access token
• Use multiple temporary email addresses in one app

KEY FEATURES

• Instant Temporary Email
Open the app and get a ready-to-use disposable email address in seconds.

• Multiple Email Addresses
Create and manage multiple temp mail inboxes in one place.

• Restore with Access Token
Recover and reuse your email address securely using your access token, even after reinstalling the app or switching devices.

• Real-time Notifications
Get notified as soon as a new email arrives.

• Fast Global Email Delivery
Powered by Google’s global email server network for fast and reliable incoming email delivery.

• Privacy Protection
No personal information required. Stay anonymous while signing up for websites and apps.

• Anti-Tracking Protection
Built-in image proxy helps reduce email tracking pixels and removes common tracking elements from incoming emails.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

• What is Temp Mail?
Temp Mail (also called disposable email, fake email, burner email, or 10 minute mail) is a temporary email service used to protect privacy and avoid spam.

• Is Temp Mail free?
Yes. Temp Mail by Tmailor.com is free to use.

• Can I receive OTP and verification emails?
Yes. Temp Mail works with many websites and apps for verification emails and OTP codes.

• Can I keep and reuse my email address?
Yes. You can restore and reuse your email address using your access token.

• Can I send emails?
No. This app supports receiving emails only.

• Why do emails disappear after 24 hours?
To protect privacy and reduce abuse of temporary email addresses.

• Can I use Temp Mail on multiple devices?
Yes. You can restore access to your email address on another device using your token.

IMPORTANT NOTES

• This app supports receiving emails only (no sending)
• Temporary email is not recommended for important accounts (banking, primary accounts, or long-term recovery)
• We are not affiliated with Gmail and do not provide @gmail.com addresses

Live Transcribe - Speech to Text

Transform spoken words into text instantly with Live Transcribe - Speech to Text. This innovative application is designed specifically for individuals who value effective communication. Whether you’re a student, a professional, or someone who is deaf or hard of hearing, Live Transcribe - Speech to Text is tailored to enhance your communication experience seamlessly and efficiently.

Key Features of Live Transcribe:

- Real-Time Transcription: Experience the power of real-time speech-to-text conversion with Live Transcribe. This app employs advanced speech recognition technology to ensure you capture conversations instantly. Perfect for lectures, meetings, or casual discussions, Live Transcribe ensures you never miss a word spoken and gives you the confidence of knowing you have accurate text outputs.

- Designed for the Hearing Impaired: Live Transcribe - Speech to Text is a crucial tool for individuals who are hearing impaired. With immediate text outputs, Live Transcribe ensures that everyone can actively engage in conversations. This app fosters an inclusive environment both in personal and professional contexts, making it easy for users to participate without barriers.

- User-Friendly Interface: Navigate effortlessly with the intuitive design of Live Transcribe. The user-friendly interface of Live Transcribe - Speech to Text is accessible for users of all ages, allowing quick adjustments to personalized settings for all your transcription needs.

- Multilingual Capabilities: Break down language barriers effortlessly with multi-language support in Live Transcribe. Whether you're speaking Spanish, French, or any other language, Live Transcribe - Speech to Text accommodates various languages, making it perfect for multicultural interactions and diverse communities.

- Export and Sharing Options: Save your transcriptions for future reference! With Live Transcribe, you can easily export conversations into PDF or text files, simplifying the process of creating study materials or sharing important meeting notes with colleagues.

Who Can Benefit from Live Transcribe - Speech to Text?

- Students: Capture every important detail during lectures to enhance your academic performance. Live Transcribe - Speech to Text acts as an essential study aid, ensuring you never miss crucial points discussed in class.

- Professionals: Improve your productivity and efficiency in meetings. With reliable transcription services from Live Transcribe, you can focus on listening and engaging in the conversation rather than worrying about note-taking, ensuring that every vital piece of information is accurately recorded and available for later review.

- Educators: Use Live Transcribe to create accessible lesson plans that cater to the needs of all students. By utilizing Live Transcribe - Speech to Text, you can provide valuable resources for your classroom, promoting inclusivity and engagement among all learners.

- Deaf and Hard of Hearing Communities: Live Transcribe significantly enhances communication abilities in both personal and professional environments. It bridges gaps in conversation, enabling individuals to participate fully in discussions without barriers, ensuring a more inclusive experience.

Why Choose Live Transcribe - Speech to Text?

Effective communication is more critical than ever in today’s fast-paced world. Live Transcribe - Speech to Text provides a comprehensive solution for anyone seeking to improve accessibility. Its robust features allow for the easy conversion of spoken language into written text, helping users navigate conversations smoothly and eliminating barriers that hinder communication.

With Live Transcribe, you can take control of your communication experience in busy lecture halls, office meetings.

it.name: Weather Fit: Outfit Planner
it.d:
Get dressed for the weather, not just told about it.

Weather Fit turns the forecast into something you can see. A character that looks like you puts on clothes that match the conditions outside, so before you even read the temperature, you already know if it's a sweater day, a raincoat day, or a sunglasses day.

Hourly, daily, and minute by minute forecasts powered by Apple Weather. Made for iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch.

WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT

A character that dresses for the day. Morning, afternoon, evening, and night, your character changes clothes as the weather changes. It's the fastest way to know what to wear before you walk out the door.

Dressed like you. Pick a character, choose a hairstyle, skin tone, and hair color, then pick their clothes: jackets, sweaters, shirts, dresses, shoes, and accessories. Only what you'd actually wear.

Outfits tuned to you. A comfort slider tells the app whether you run hot or cold, and the suggestions adjust. No more being told to wear a coat when you're already sweating.

Forecasts that cover everything. Next hour precipitation, weather alerts, and a stats grid for UV, wind, air quality, humidity, pressure, visibility, sunrise and sunset, and moon phase.

Beautiful to look at. Animated landscapes, dynamic skies, and weather effects that shift with the time of day. Pick from City, Mountains, Beach, or Village.

NOTIFICATIONS

Wake up knowing what to wear. Your character gets dressed for the day and arrives in a morning notification, with an evening one to plan tomorrow. And when rain or strong sun is coming, a reminder tells you to grab an umbrella or sunscreen.

WIDGETS

Home Screen widgets in every size, with or without your character on them. Lock Screen widgets too, inline above the clock and circular or rectangular below it, so the forecast and your outfit are one glance away.

APPLE WATCH

A full Weather Fit app on the wrist, plus complications for your favorite watch face. Your character, the temperature, and what's coming next, right where you'll see it.

WEATHER MAPS

Animated precipitation radar from Rainbow.ai. Watch rain and snow move across the map for the next hour, frame by frame.

ICLOUD SYNC

Your character, wardrobe, saved locations, and settings stay in sync across all your devices and back up to iCloud automatically. Switch phones without losing a thing.

WEATHER FIT PREMIUM

A subscription unlocks the full experience:

- Unlimited wardrobe items and outfit combinations
- All four landscapes (City, Mountains, Beach, Village)
- Weather report and reminder notifications
- Every Home Screen and Lock Screen widget
- The Apple Watch app and complications
- Weather Maps with precipitation radar

Choose monthly, yearly, or a one time lifetime purchase. Free trial available for new subscribers.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel anytime from your App Store account settings.

it.name: Zoom Earth - Weather Forecast
it.d:
INTERACTIVE WEATHER MAP

Zoom Earth is an interactive weather map of the world and a real-time hurricane tracker.

Explore the current weather and see forecasts for your location through interactive weather maps of rain, wind, temperature, pressure, and more.

With Zoom Earth, you can track the development of hurricanes, storms, and severe weather, monitor wildfires and smoke, and stay aware of the latest conditions by viewing satellite imagery updated in near real‑time.



SATELLITE IMAGERY

Zoom Earth shows weather maps with near real-time satellite imagery.

Live satellite images from NOAA GOES, JMA Himawari, and EUMETSAT Meteosat geostationary satellites are updated every 10 minutes.

HD satellite images are updated twice a day from NASA polar-orbiting satellites Aqua and Terra.



RAIN RADAR & NOWCAST

Stay ahead of the storm with our weather radar map, which shows rain and snow detected by ground-based Doppler radar in real-time, and provides an instant short-term weather forecast with radar nowcasting.



WEATHER FORECAST MAPS

Explore beautiful, interactive visualizations of the weather with our stunning global forecast maps. Our maps are continually updated with the latest weather forecast model data from DWD ICON and NOAA/NCEP/NWS GFS. Weather forecast maps include:

Precipitation Forecast - Rain, snow, and cloud cover, all in one map.

Wind Speed Forecast - Average speed and direction of surface winds.

Wind Gusts Forecast - Maximum speed of sudden bursts of wind.

Temperature Forecast - Air temperatures at 2 meters (6 feet) above the ground.

“Feels Like” Temperature Forecast - Perceived temperatures, also known as apparent temperature or heat index.

Relative Humidity Forecast - How air moisture compares to temperature.

Dew Point Temperature Forecast - How dry or humid the air feels, and the point at which condensation occurs.

Wet-Bulb Temperature Forecast - Heat stress levels.

Atmospheric Pressure Forecast - The average atmospheric pressure at sea level. Low-pressure areas often bring cloudy and windy weather. High-pressure areas are associated with clear skies and lighter winds.



HURRICANE TRACKING

Follow hurricanes from development to category 5 in real-time with our best-in-class tropical tracking system. Information is clear and easy to understand. Our hurricane tracking weather maps are updated using the very latest data from NHC, JTWC, NRL, and IBTrACS.



WILDFIRE TRACKING

Monitor wildfires with our active fires and heat spots overlay, which shows points of very high temperature detected by satellite. Detections are updated daily with data from NASA FIRMS. Use in conjunction with our GeoColor satellite imagery to see the movement of wildfire smoke and monitor fire weather in near real-time.



CUSTOMIZATION

Adjust temperature units, wind units, time zone, animation styles, and many more features with our comprehensive settings.



ZOOM EARTH PRO

More features are available through auto-renewable subscriptions. Payment will be charged to your App Store account at the confirmation of purchase. The subscription will automatically renew at the end of each billing period and be charged within 24 hours, unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. For further information, please read our Terms of Service.



LEGAL

it.name: zTranslate - Translate Youtube
it.d:
If you want to watch a movie but it doesn't have subtitles available for your language? Don't worry, because this app will be the best solution for you.

This app will use the video's original subtitles, then translate it into various languages, support over 110 languages.

Feature:
Watch Youtube videos with subtitles in your language
Choose a video with subtitles, and translate it into any language you want.

Compare subtitle for foreign language learning
Simultaneous display of the original subtitle and the translated subtitle, so that learners can compare 2 sentences.

Lookup dictionary
You can immediately look up the dictionary by tap the word.

The shadowing technique
Shadowing is a language learning technique where you repeat an audio just after you hear it. You’re acting like an “echo” or a “shadow” (hence the name “shadowing"). You listen to the words and then say them back out loud. Shadowing helps you develop all the physical aspects of fluency. These include things like pronunciation, prosody, and rhythm of English. It looks like this:
1. Find a video of your interest
2. Listen to the audio from video first
3. Shadow the audio with a transcript
4. Shadow without a transcript

Other
Support full screen mode
Favorite video
Add videos to favorites and watch them later

How do I use:
Open the app and select the video you want to watch.
You can enter keywords to search for videos, note that only videos with closed captions will be displayed.


Note:
This app only translates from existing subtitles of the video, because not all Youtube videos have subtitles, so some videos cannot be translated.

it.name: gterm: Ghostty SSH
it.d:
gterm is a real terminal for iOS. It renders with Ghostty's GPU engine for true xterm/VT emulation, connects straight to your servers over SSH, keeps your keys on device, and ships an AI command assistant that writes the commands for you.

It's the same renderer and VT parser as the Ghostty desktop app. iOS can't fork/exec a local shell, so gterm drives the terminal straight from the SSH stream through a custom passthru IO backend added to libghostty — giving you a real terminal in a sandboxed iOS surface.

GPU-RENDERED TERMINAL
Real xterm/VT emulation via Ghostty's libghostty, drawn on Metal. Colors, ligatures, and reflow that feel native — not a web shim.

SSH-NATIVE
Connects with swift-nio-ssh — password and public-key auth, a PTY shell, live window resizing, and trust-on-first-use host-key verification.

KEYS STAY ON DEVICE
Import Ed25519 / ECDSA private keys into the iOS Keychain — device-only, never synced. Pick one or more keys to try per host.

SHELL-GRADE KEYBOARD
A custom accessory keyboard with the keys iOS forgets — Esc, Ctrl, Alt, Tab, arrows, and sticky modifiers for real TUI navigation.

AI COMMAND ASSISTANT
Describe what you want in plain English. The AI reads your recent commands and visible screen, proposes a command, and shows it to you for review before it runs.

AI AUTO-COMPLETION
As you type, suggestions surface above the keyboard — from your history and from your provider. Bring your own key; it's stored masked in the Keychain.

Open source: https://github.com/madeye/gterm

iPadOS Support

No Telemetry
Your privacy matters. Harbour is committed to respecting your privacy by ensuring that no telemetry data is collected :)

it.name: HTTPBot: API & HTTP Client
it.d:
HTTPBot is a powerful API client and debugger that lets you send HTTP/HTTPs requests, connect to WebSockets, browse and invoke remote MCP servers, inspect JSON & HTML responses, and debug APIs on the go.

With HTTPBot, you can
    - Make requests and view responses from anywhere.
    - Debug API issues even while away from your terminal.  
    - Work with JSON, HTML, XML, and raw text responses effortlessly.
    - Collaborate with your team by importing & exporting Postman collections, and by syncing with the Postman API.

FEATURES
    - Powerful request editor provides a GUI for easily editing HTTP, HTTPS & WebSockets requests.
    - Connect to remote MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers to browse and invoke their tools, prompts, and resources.
    - Supports all major HTTP methods, including GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, HEAD, and OPTIONS.
    - Automatically highlights JSON, HTML, and XML content for better readability. 
    - View detailed metrics for requests and responses, including size, duration, SSL and more.   
    - Support for OpenAPI/Swagger specs as well as Postman collections & environments, including sync with Postman accounts on the cloud 
    - View request documentation for APIs
    - Native support for GraphQL requests - edit queries and variables directly, and view schema.
    - Import & export collections from/to any document storage provider, like iCloud Drive, Dropbox and more.
    - Supports authentication using Basic, Digest, OAuth 1.0a, OAuth 2.0, JWT and much more. Securely store auth credentials for frequent use.
    - Save frequently-used variables in environments
    - Filter & query responses using XPath & JSONPath
    - Automate your workflows with Shortcuts integration.

PRICING
HTTPBot is available to download for free, with a risk-free 7-day trial to unlock access to its features. Enjoy full access beyond the trial with a yearly subscription, or a one-time purchase for a lifetime upgrade. All plans unlock the app on all platforms where it is supported.

LEGAL
Duration & price of each subscription is displayed in the app when upgrading to Pro. Payment will be charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew unless it is cancelled atleast 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage your subscription in your iTunes account settings. Any unused portion of the free trial period is forfeited as soon as a subscription is purchased.

it.name: Incognito — Private Browser
it.d:
Incognito is a private web browser you can pull up anywhere. From any app: long-press a link or select text, tap Share, and then choose the Incognito action extension. Boom: instant web browser!

Need to lock people out of your web history or bookmarks? Incognito can do that too!

Incognito is great for:
• Viewing a web page inside the current app without jumping to Safari.
• Opening sketchy links without risking your privacy.
• Reopening a web page with cookies disabled — and yes, that means Incognito lets you dodge most paywalls.
• Searching Google from anywhere — just select the text you want to search, choose “Share” from the popup menu, and then choose the “Search in Incognito” action.
• Searching with something besides Google: use Kagi, DuckDuckGo, Bing, Brave, Qwant, Yahoo, or whatever search engine you prefer.
• Keeping your web history and bookmarks private and passcode-locked. Or you can disable browsing history and leave no trace!

Incognito is also a Swiss Army Knife of web tools:
• Open a page in another browser such as Safari, Chrome, Firefox, Opera, Brave, or DuckDuckGo.
• Remove AMP so you can browse or share the original URL. 
• Translate the page using Google Translate (beta).
• Open a web page with the archive.today service (Incognito is not affiliated with archive.today or archive.is).
• Save a PDF of an entire web page.
• Set Incognito as your default browser.
• Clear your session history.

Incognito is all about privacy:
• All web browsing is in “private mode” by default, so all cookies and web data are discarded after each session.
• Incognito has no ads, no third-party trackers, and does not send or re-route your web searches anywhere.
• If you require extra privacy, Incognito has options to disable browsing history and/or exclude it from your iCloud Backups.

Incognito is paid upfront with a small, one-time fee. There are no subscriptions, in-app purchases, ads, or deals with sketchy "search engines" like many of the "free" so-called private browser apps. You can trust me with your privacy because you know how I got paid: once, by you, that's it.

Incognito was created by an independent developer living in California.

Onion Browser is the original free and open-source Tor-powered web browser for iOS. Onion Browser helps you access the internet with more safety and privacy, and no extra cost to you.

“The best Tor-related offering on iOS right now is Onion Browser” - The Daily Dot, October 14, 2015.

FEATURES:
• Browse the internet over Tor:
- Protect your privacy from website tracking
- Secure your traffic from insecure wireless networks and ISPs
- Access .onion sites that are only accessible over Tor.

• Fight online tracking: block scripts and automatically clear cookies and tabs, based on your preferences.

• And more privacy-enhancing features!

DISCLAIMERS:
- Web browsing is much slower than through a normal web browser or a VPN because your traffic is encrypted and relayed through the Tor network.

- Onion Browser might not work on networks with advanced network restrictions. If the app does not connect, try using bridges (or a different type of bridge), force-quit, and then restart the app.

- Use of Onion Browser is at your own risk; remember that sensitive data does not always belong on a mobile device.

** Onion Browser is free and open-source software. You can read more about Onion Browser and how to support development of Tor on iOS by visiting onionbrowser.com **

As artificial intelligence technology has become widely available, many people may turn to chatbots like ChatGPT for answers to their Islamic questions. However, it is important to recognize that these tools are not specifically designed or trained to address critical and sensitive issues related to faith and religion. Here we find the revolutionary alternative "Islamic AI" app that serves as an excellent replacement, allowing users to harness the power of artificial intelligence while ensuring they receive accurate and reliable answers in accordance with Islamic teachings.

"Islamic AI" connects you to the wealth of knowledge from authentic Arabic sources, unlocking their wisdom and making it available to you in your preferred language. Regardless of where you're from or which language you speak, "Islamic AI" understands the importance of catering to a global audience and helping them understand critical Islamic concepts. With advanced AI-driven translation capabilities, the app can accurately answer your questions by sourcing information from reliable sources in Arabic, translating it, and presenting it to you in your language. Experience the ease of learning with "Islamic AI" as it breaks down language barriers for better accessibility.

◦ Get instant answers to your Islamic questions using advanced AI technology.
